items.title: TCSAlgBench: Benchmarking Automated Proving for Research-Level Theoretical Computer Science
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models perform strongly on competition mathematics, but their research-level reasoning remains difficult to evaluate systematically. Theoretical computer science (TCS) connects algorithm design to explicit guarantees and fundamental limits, providing a setting for evaluating whether models can justify computational improvements with arguments humans can inspect. We introduce TCSAlgBench, a benchmark and reusable pipeline for natural-language proof discovery, comprising 398 theorem-level challenges from 138 STOC and COLT 2026 papers. Expert-designed rules complete paper-specific context, preserve computational assumptions and quantitative guarantees, and withhold constructions when discovering an algorithm is part of the task. For each task, prover systems receive theorem statements and access to cited prior work. The pipeline supports fresh, versioned challenge batches from newly released papers. We evaluate ten model configurations from four families under direct inference and prover-verifier discussion, and compare four agent workflows under matched model-call opportunities. All evaluations use the full benchmark. In the model comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol max achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 23.6% after 10-round discussion. Discussion and repeated sampling improve coverage. In the separate agent comparison using GPT-5.5 xhigh, decomposition improves coverage over discussion, and agentic planning achieves the highest five-run verifier-accepted coverage at 25.4%. TCSAlgBench provides a refreshable testbed for measuring progress in model reasoning and studying how agent workflows support research-level proof discovery.
items.summary_zh: TCSAlgBench 从 STOC 和 COLT 论文中构建可刷新、定理级的理论计算机科学自动证明基准，并比较模型和 agent 工作流。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务保留计算假设与定量保证，使用 verifier-accepted coverage 作为可检查指标，能更接近研究级证明发现而非竞赛题拟合。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型在竞赛数学上表现很强，但其研究级推理仍难以系统评估。理论计算机科学（TCS）把算法设计与明确保证及基本极限联系起来，为评估模型能否用人类可检查的论证证明计算改进提供了一个场景。我们提出 TCSAlgBench，一个用于自然语言证明发现的基准和可复用流水线，其中包含来自 138 篇 STOC 和 COLT 2026 论文的 398 个定理级挑战。专家设计的规则补充论文特定上下文，保留计算假设和定量保证；当任务要求发现算法时，则隐藏构造。对于每项任务，证明器系统接收定理陈述，并可访问所引用的先前工作。该流水线支持根据新发布论文生成全新的、有版本标识的挑战批次。我们在直接推理和 prover-verifier 讨论两种设置下，评估来自四个家族的十种模型配置，并在匹配模型调用机会的条件下比较四种 agent 工作流。所有评估都使用完整基准。在模型比较中，GPT-5.6 Sol max 在 10 轮讨论后取得最高的五次运行 verifier-accepted coverage，为 23.6%。讨论和重复采样都会提高覆盖率。在独立的 agent 比较中，使用 GPT-5.5 xhigh，分解相较于讨论提高了覆盖率，而 agentic planning 取得最高的五次运行 verifier-accepted coverage，为 25.4%。TCSAlgBench 提供了一个可刷新测试台，用于测量模型推理进展，并研究 agent 工作流如何支持研究级证明发现。

items.abstract_or_text: What do you want from AI? We’re launching a new study with Anthropic Interviewer to learn more about your experiences using AI, what role you want it to play in your life and the world, and what you want from the companies building it. Last December, 81,000 people told us about their hopes and fears about AI in the largest qualitative study ever done. This time, we’re giving participants the option to make their responses public so that anyone, not just Anthropic, can learn from them. The study runs Sept 29 to Oct 6 and is open to Free, Pro, and Max users on Claude and Claude Code.

items.title: DECIPHER integrates disentangled representation learning and prototype-based cell-type deconvolution across molecular modalities
items.abstract_or_text: The growing availability of single-cell resources creates new opportunities to extract cell-type-resolved information from the vast body of existing bulk omics data through cell-type deconvolution. Conventional deconvolution methods often rely on linear mixture models or specific probabilistic assumptions and can be sensitive to batch effects, whereas many deep-learning approaches are modality-specific or lack a unified end-to-end learning framework. Here, we developed DECIPHER, an end-to-end representation-learning framework for cell-type deconvolution that can be applied across multiple molecular modalities. DECIPHER learns a domain-constant representation (Zc) for deconvolution and a domain-specific representation (Zs) to model domain-associated variation. By integrating nonlinear representation learning with differentiable non-negative least-squares optimization, DECIPHER estimates cell-type proportions from Zc. Across simulated datasets, experimentally generated bulk-cell mixtures, real-world datasets, and multiple molecular modalities, DECIPHER showed robust and competitive cell-type deconvolution performance. Beyond cell-type proportion estimation, the learned Zc supported chronological age prediction across independent cohorts and prognostic stratification in lung adenocarcinoma, demonstrating that DECIPHER can transform high-dimensional bulk omics data into low-dimensional, biologically informative representations. DECIPHER thus broadens the utility of existing bulk omics resources for biological discovery and clinical research.
items.summary_zh: DECIPHER 用 domain-constant 与 domain-specific 表征结合可微 non-negative least-squares，在多种分子模态和多类数据集上进行 cell-type deconvolution。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将 bulk omics 转换为细胞类型比例和低维生物学表征，并在独立队列中支持年龄预测和肺腺癌预后分层；预后用途仍需进一步验证。
items.abstract_zh: 单细胞资源不断增加，为从大量既有 bulk omics 数据中提取细胞类型分辨信息创造了新机会，这可以通过 cell-type deconvolution 实现。传统 deconvolution 方法通常依赖线性混合模型或特定的概率假设，并且可能对批次效应敏感；许多深度学习方法则具有模态特异性，或缺少统一的端到端学习框架。在此，我们开发了 DECIPHER，一个可应用于多种分子模态的端到端表征学习框架，用于 cell-type deconvolution。DECIPHER 学习一个用于 deconvolution 的 domain-constant representation（Zc）和一个用于建模领域相关变异的 domain-specific representation（Zs）。通过将非线性表征学习与可微的 non-negative least-squares 优化结合，DECIPHER 从 Zc 估计细胞类型比例。在模拟数据集、实验生成的 bulk-cell mixtures、真实世界数据集以及多种分子模态上，DECIPHER 都显示出稳健且具有竞争力的 cell-type deconvolution 性能。除了估计细胞类型比例之外，所学习的 Zc 还支持在独立队列中预测生理年龄，并对 lung adenocarcinoma 进行预后分层，表明 DECIPHER 可以将高维 bulk omics 数据转换为低维且具有生物学信息的表征。因此，DECIPHER 扩展了既有 bulk omics 资源在生物学发现和临床研究中的用途。
items.author_line: Lai, W., Li, C., Deng, Q., Zhu, Y., Liu, C., Li, Z., Luo, O. J.

items.title: Drug-Target Interaction Prediction via Hierarchical Sequential Cross-Attention over Chemical and Protein Language Models
items.abstract_or_text: Predicting Drug-Target Interactions~(DTIs) is a central task in computational drug discovery, with direct applications in virtual screening, drug repurposing, and therapeutic candidate prioritization. Although recent deep learning methods have improved DTI prediction, many sequence-based models still process drugs and proteins independently and only combine their representations at a late prediction stage. This limits their ability to explicitly model cross-molecular dependencies between chemical substructures and protein sequence regions. In this paper, we propose a sequence-only DTI prediction architecture that combines two pre-trained language models, ChemBERTa for drug SMILES strings and ESM-2 for protein amino acid sequences, with a hierarchical interaction module. The proposed model first extracts contextual representations using pre-trained encoders, then applies 1D convolutional layers to condense local sequence patterns, followed by a sequential bidirectional cross-attention mechanism inspired by the induced-fit view of molecular recognition. Finally, attention-based pooling constructs fixed-size interaction-aware vectors for binary prediction. Experiments on BIOSNAP, Davis, and BindingDB show that the proposed model achieves the best performance on BIOSNAP, matches the best AUROC on Davis, and remains competitive on BindingDB while using only 25.2 million trainable parameters. Ablation results confirm the contribution of both the CNN and cross-attention modules, and cold-start experiments indicate promising generalization to unseen proteins and drugs.
items.summary_zh: 该序列模型将ChemBERTa和ESM-2的药物与蛋白质表示输入分层交互模块，以卷积提取局部模式，再用双向交叉注意力建模化学亚结构与蛋白序列区域的相互作用；在BIOSNAP、Davis和BindingDB上表现具有竞争力，并以25.2 million可训练参数实现冷启动评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法把药物—靶点相互作用从后期拼接推进到显式跨分子建模，并报告了消融和未见药物/蛋白质泛化结果。限制是仍为序列-only模型，缺少结构信息，冷启动表现和数据泄漏风险需进一步核查。
items.abstract_zh: 药物—靶点相互作用（DTI）预测是计算药物发现的核心任务，直接应用于虚拟筛选、药物再利用和治疗候选物优先级排序。尽管近期深度学习方法改进了DTI预测，但许多基于序列的模型仍然独立处理药物和蛋白质，仅在预测阶段后期合并它们的表示。这限制了模型显式建模化学亚结构与蛋白质序列区域之间跨分子依赖关系的能力。在本文中，我们提出一种仅基于序列的DTI预测架构，将两个预训练语言模型结合起来：用于药物SMILES字符串的ChemBERTa和用于蛋白质氨基酸序列的ESM-2，并配合分层交互模块。该模型首先利用预训练编码器提取上下文表示，然后使用一维卷积层压缩局部序列模式，接着采用受诱导契合分子识别观点启发的序列式双向交叉注意力机制。最后，通过基于注意力的池化构建固定大小的、具有交互意识的向量，用于二元预测。在BIOSNAP、Davis和BindingDB上的实验表明，该模型在BIOSNAP上取得最佳性能，在Davis上达到最佳AUROC，并在BindingDB上保持竞争力，同时只使用25.2 million个可训练参数。消融结果证实CNN和交叉注意力模块的贡献，冷启动实验表明其对未见过的蛋白质和药物具有有希望的泛化能力。
items.author_line: Khadidja Henni, Hamza Abdelali, Abdelkrim Aries, Neila Mezghani, Brigitte Vannier, Sara Magdouli, Lina Abou-Abbas

items.title: ProofLoom: Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction for Autoformalizing Research-Level Stochastic Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Formalizing research-level stochastic optimization in Lean requires both an algorithm model and domain theory connecting foundational libraries to convergence proofs. Revising a model to restore provability can change the mathematical claim. We introduce ProofLoom, a fully automated LLM-agent system for Proof-Obligation-Driven Theory Construction. Given a published algorithm, target theorem, and source proof, ProofLoom autonomously constructs the Lean model and supporting theory. Open proof obligations drive the development of definitions, interfaces, lemmas, and proof plans. Signature contracts record evidence and obligations for model revisions; an independent Judge rejects unsupported assumptions and weakened conclusions. Planner expands the published argument into intermediate claims, and Audit checks whether the Lean proof follows it. Across tasks, SOptLib accumulates verified mathematics and construction experience: reusable results are extracted, generalized, and verified, while modeling decisions and failed proof routes are recorded. Later tasks retrieve these results and records and contribute new developments, forming a cycle of construction, accumulation, and reuse. On fifteen textbook and research-paper tasks, ProofLoom obtains mean human ratings of 6.3/7 and 6.4/7, compared with 4.9/7 and 5.0/7 for the strongest of six baselines. Across 33 developments, it produces 490,693 lines of algorithm-local Lean code with no sorry. The formalizations also expose 28 incorrect formulas, proof gaps, and algorithm-analysis mismatches in published sources across 22 developments, each with checked evidence.
items.summary_zh: ProofLoom 以证明义务驱动的方式自动构建研究级随机优化的 Lean 理论，并用独立审查约束模型假设和结论。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 33 项开发中生成无 sorry 的 Lean 代码，并对公开来源发现可检查的公式错误、证明缺口和算法分析不一致，直接体现证明助手的核验价值。
items.abstract_zh: 在 Lean 中形式化研究级随机优化，需要同时具备算法模型，以及把基础库连接到收敛性证明的领域理论。修改模型以恢复可证性，可能会改变数学主张。我们提出 ProofLoom，一个完全自动化的 LLM agent 系统，用于证明义务驱动的理论构建。给定一个已发表的算法、目标定理和源证明，ProofLoom 会自主构建 Lean 模型及其支撑理论。未完成的证明义务驱动定义、接口、引理和证明计划的开发。签名契约记录模型修改的证据和义务；独立的 Judge 会拒绝没有支持的假设和被削弱的结论。Planner 将已发表的论证扩展为中间主张，Audit 则检查 Lean 证明是否遵循该论证。在多个任务中，SOptLib 积累经过验证的数学和构建经验：它提取、推广并验证可复用结果，同时记录建模决策和失败的证明路径。后续任务检索这些结果和记录，并贡献新的发展，形成构建、积累和复用的循环。在 15 个教材和研究论文任务上，ProofLoom 获得的人类平均评分分别为 6.3/7 和 6.4/7，而六个基线中最强者分别为 4.9/7 和 5.0/7。在 33 项开发中，它生成了 490,693 行算法局部 Lean 代码，且没有使用 sorry。这些形式化还在 22 项开发中发现了已发表来源中的 28 个错误公式、证明缺口和算法—分析不一致，每一项都有经过检查的证据。
items.author_line: Feiming Wang, Daibo Li, Kun Yuan

items.title: LLM sequential decision making under uncertainty in biochemical domains
items.abstract_or_text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to drive scientific discovery. Understanding how LLMs make decisions from new data and memory of the literature is vital before trusting them to design experiments under tight experimental budgets. However, their decision strategies are invisible in the current performance scores used to evaluate research agents. Here, we benchmark five frontier LLMs in a Bayesian Optimization setting against published statistical baselines on seven combinatorial datasets spanning protein engineering, reaction optimization, molecular design, peptide self-assembly, and catalysis. Performance is paired with direct measurements of model beliefs and actions, enabling highly resolved behavior analysis. A prompt ablation that progressively strips context separates memorization from chemical reasoning and from bare categorical optimization. Prior chemical knowledge helps in expectation, but with high variance and occasionally even harms performance. No configuration tested decisively beats a mean statistical baseline across domains. Belief-movement and Martingale diagnostics, corrected here for a measurement-noise bias that mislabels rational agents as irrational, show that models overreact to incoming data rather than entrenching on their priors in the contexts studied here. Interestingly, while LLM actions are exploitative, models sincerely intend to explore and consistently act on that intent. This failure is a competence gap arising from context-stickiness. Removing in-context history restores exploration, indicating that priors and data must be decoupled to achieve effective LLM-driven discovery.
items.summary_zh: 在涵盖蛋白工程、反应优化、分子设计、肽自组装和催化的7个组合数据集上，将5个前沿LLM置于贝叶斯优化环境中，与统计基线比较，并直接测量模型信念和行动。研究通过提示消融区分记忆、化学推理和一般优化能力，发现模型常过度响应新数据、行动偏开发且上下文黏滞；去除上下文历史可恢复探索行为。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把化学智能体的决策过程从单一性能分数扩展到信念—行动诊断，指出LLM在科学发现中的系统性探索缺陷。限制是所有结论来自特定基准、提示和仿真式优化设置，尚不能直接外推到真实实验。
items.abstract_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被用于推动科学发现。在信任它们用有限实验预算设计实验之前，理解LLM如何根据新数据和文献记忆做出决策至关重要。然而，在当前用于评估研究智能体的性能分数中，它们的决策策略是不可见的。我们在贝叶斯优化设置下，对5个前沿LLM进行了基准测试，并与已发表的统计基线比较；所用7个组合数据集覆盖蛋白工程、反应优化、分子设计、肽自组装和催化。我们将性能与对模型信念和行动的直接测量配对，从而实现高分辨率的行为分析。逐步剥离上下文的提示消融，将记忆与化学推理以及纯粹的类别优化区分开来。先验化学知识在期望意义上有所帮助，但方差很大，偶尔甚至会损害性能。在所研究的领域中，没有一种测试配置能够明确击败平均统计基线。经过校正会把理性智能体误判为非理性智能体的测量噪声偏差后，信念移动和鞅诊断显示，模型对新进入的数据反应过度，而不是固守其先验。有趣的是，尽管LLM的行动具有开发性，模型却真诚地意图进行探索，并始终依据这种意图行动。这种失败源于上下文黏滞性所造成的能力鸿沟。移除上下文历史能够恢复探索，说明要实现有效的LLM驱动发现，必须将先验与数据解耦。
items.author_line: Mattias Akke, Soojung Yang, Jurgis Ruža, Sathya Edamadaka, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli

items.title: @EinsiaAI：The next test for AI agents is not just whether they can write code. It is whether they can look, understand, code, insp
items.abstract_or_text: The next test for AI agents is not just whether they can write code. It is whether they can look, understand, code, inspect—and fix. Today we’re releasing PPTBench, a benchmark for Visual Coding through scientific diagram slides reconstruction. 500 tasks. 36 configurations. 18,000 reconstructions. 64.03% failed the semantic check. Only 2.57% passed all gates with no recorded defect. Visual coding is still wide open.
items.summary_zh: Einsia发布PPTBench，用科学示意图幻灯片重建测试视觉编码；500个任务、36种配置、18,000次重建中，64.03%未通过语义检查，仅2.57%通过全部闸门且无记录缺陷。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 候选帖文给出了任务规模和失败率，显示视觉编码距离可靠落地仍有明显差距；这些是作者公布的基准结果。
items.abstract_zh: AI代理面临的下一项测试，不只是能否编写代码，还要看它们能否观察、理解、编码、检查并修复。今天我们发布PPTBench，这是一个通过重建科学示意图幻灯片来评测视觉编码的基准。500个任务、36种配置、18,000次重建。64.03%未通过语义检查。只有2.57%通过全部闸门且没有记录缺陷。视觉编码仍有很大的探索空间。
items.author_line: Einsia

items.title: @NVIDIAAI：A video world model can make a convincing clip and still get the physics wrong. Our researchers just released Physis-Lan
items.abstract_or_text: A video world model can make a convincing clip and still get the physics wrong. Our researchers just released Physis-Lang, an open self-evolving framework that adds physics reasoning to video captions. The captions explain why and how a scene unfolds. We use them to fine-tune world models and add that reasoning to prompts when generating video. Adding physics reasoning to the prompt alone improved NVIDIA Cosmos 3’s PhyGenBench score by 5.62 points without retraining. Paper and project:

items.title: Compartmentalized Nanozyme Transduction Enables Regenerative Molecular Amplification for Multiplexed miRNA-Based Prostate Cancer Stratification
items.abstract_or_text: Circulating microRNAs (miRNAs) have emerged as promising liquid biopsy markers; however, their clinical translation is restricted by low abundance, biological heterogeneity, and the complexity of multiplex profiling. Herein, we develop a targeted cycling-mediated duplex-specific nuclease (DSN)-nanozyme signal amplification platform (TC-DSN-Nano) that establishes a compartmentalized catalytic transduction strategy for multiplexed miRNA analysis. By encapsulating gold nanozymes within liposomal nanoreactors, this platform spatially separates molecular recognition from catalytic signal generation, preserving nanozyme activity during sensor construction. Upon target miRNA recognition, DSN-mediated recycling induces regenerative release of nanozyme-loaded liposomes from magnetic substrates, converting individual miRNA molecules into amplified catalytic outputs without conventional nucleic acid amplification. The platform enables programmable profiling of six prostate cancer (PCa) associated miRNAs in serum samples. Furthermore, machine learning-assisted integration of multiplexed miRNA signatures enables accurate discrimination among healthy donors, nonmetastatic PCa patients, and metastatic PCa patients, achieving an overall classification accuracy of 90.5%. This work establishes a general compartmentalized nanozyme transduction framework that integrates molecular recycling, catalytic amplification, and computational analysis for liquid biopsy-based cancer stratification.

items.abstract_zh: 循环microRNA（miRNA）已成为有前景的液体活检标志物；然而，其临床转化受到丰度低、生物异质性以及多重分析复杂性的限制。在这里，我们开发了靶向循环介导的双链特异性核酸酶（DSN）—纳米酶信号放大平台（TC-DSN-Nano），建立用于多重miRNA分析的区室化催化转导策略。通过将金纳米酶封装在脂质体纳米反应器中，该平台在空间上分隔分子识别与催化信号生成，从而在传感器构建过程中保持纳米酶活性。识别目标miRNA后，DSN介导的循环会诱导装载纳米酶的脂质体从磁性基底再生式释放，将单个miRNA分子转化为放大的催化输出，而无需传统的核酸扩增。该平台能够对血清样本中的6种前列腺癌（PCa）相关miRNA进行可编程分析。此外，机器学习辅助整合多重miRNA特征后，可以准确区分健康供者、非转移性PCa患者和转移性PCa患者，总体分类准确率达到90.5%。这项工作建立了一个通用的区室化纳米酶转导框架，将分子循环、催化放大和计算分析整合用于基于液体活检的癌症分层。

items.title: A biological-response compound representation allows chemical perturbation prediction across cell lines
items.abstract_or_text: Accurately predicting cellular responses to drugs remains a challenge with the potential to reduce experimental screening costs and accelerate drug discovery. Current computational approaches represent compounds through chemical structures, which carry little information regarding their activity within biological systems. We show that gene expression responses, measured in a reference cell line, can instead serve as transferable representations of chemical perturbations. The proposed framework, BioPert, uses biological representations with a small neural network to predict transcriptional delta responses in cell lines of different lineages. Across the Tahoe-100M and LINCS L1000 datasets, BioPert outperforms molecular fingerprints and embeddings learned from chemical structure, which provide limited improvements over random controls. BioPert's prediction correlations reach 0.79 on Tahoe-100M, corresponding to an improvement of 0.34 over the next-best representation. On LINCS, performance varies with the experimental reproducibility of the test conditions, highlighting the impact of batch effects. Notably, BioPert considerably surpasses predictions obtained by copying the reference response, demonstrating that it captures context-dependent effects. Further analysis of a C32-cobimetinib case shows pathway-level accuracy of the predictions, including when the reference and target responses differ. These results open a new path for chemical perturbation prediction and could ultimately reduce the burden of phenotypic screening.
items.summary_zh: BioPert以参考细胞系的基因表达响应作为化学扰动表示，用小型神经网络预测不同谱系细胞系的转录delta响应；在Tahoe-100M和LINCS L1000上优于分子指纹及结构嵌入，Tahoe-100M相关性达到0.79。

items.abstract_zh: 准确预测细胞对药物的响应仍然是一个挑战，但这有望降低实验筛选成本并加速药物发现。当前的计算方法通过化学结构表示化合物，而化学结构对于其在生物系统中的活性信息很少。我们表明，在参考细胞系中测量的基因表达响应可以作为化学扰动的可迁移表示。所提出的框架BioPert使用生物学表示和一个小型神经网络，预测不同谱系细胞系中的转录delta响应。在Tahoe-100M和LINCS L1000数据集上，BioPert优于分子指纹以及从化学结构学习的嵌入；后者相对于随机对照的改进有限。BioPert的预测相关性在Tahoe-100M上达到0.79，比次优表示提高0.34。在LINCS上，性能随测试条件的实验重复性而变化，突出了批次效应的影响。值得注意的是，BioPert显著优于直接复制参考响应的预测，即使参考响应和目标响应不同，也能捕获依赖细胞背景的效应。对C32-cobimetinib案例的进一步分析显示，其预测具有通路层面的准确性。这些结果为化学扰动预测开辟了新路径，最终可能减少表型筛选负担。

items.title: Symmetry-Aware Flow Matching for End-to-end Molecular Crystal Generation
items.abstract_or_text: Molecular crystal packing shapes properties from drug bioavailability to charge transport, yet generating realistic structures requires coordinating molecular flexibility, intermolecular interactions and symmetry. Here we introduce SALA, a flow-matching model built on state--context separation: it evolves only asymmetric-unit (ASU) atomic coordinates and symmetry-compatible lattice parameters while predicting their updates from the full periodic environment. Conditioned on molecular graphs and a space group, SALA generates molecular conformation, lattice geometry and packing end to end while preserving the specified symmetry. Across 799 held-out crystals spanning four chemical classes and all seven crystal systems, SALA achieves a 72.0\% hit rate from 50 candidates per target, compared with 8.1\% for an atomistic full-cell generative baseline. Mean best-candidate packing root-mean-square deviation decreases from 4.48 to 1.70~Å, with the advantage widening as system size and symmetry multiplicity increase. SALA thus enables end-to-end generation of complex, symmetry-constrained molecular crystals, with potential applications in CSP, structure-based pharmaceutical polymorph design and organic molecular materials discovery.
items.summary_zh: SALA只演化不对称单元原子坐标和符合对称性的晶格参数，同时依据完整周期环境预测更新，从分子图和空间群端到端生成分子构象、晶格和堆积；在799个留出晶体上，50个候选的命中率为72.0%，而全晶胞基线为8.1%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 方法将晶体对称性直接纳入生成过程，在药物多晶型和有机分子材料发现中具有应用潜力。限制是候选命中率依赖给定空间群和数据分布，真实晶体成核与实验可制备性尚未验证。
items.abstract_zh: 分子晶体堆积决定从药物生物利用度到电荷传输等性质，但生成真实结构需要协调分子柔性、分子间相互作用和对称性。在这里，我们提出SALA，这是一种基于状态—上下文分离的流匹配模型：它只演化不对称单元（ASU）的原子坐标和符合对称性的晶格参数，同时根据完整周期环境预测它们的更新。给定分子图和空间群后，SALA端到端生成分子构象、晶格几何和堆积，同时保持指定对称性。在涵盖4个化学类别和全部7种晶系的799个留出晶体上，每个目标生成50个候选时，SALA的命中率达到72.0%，而原子级全晶胞生成基线为8.1%。最佳候选的平均堆积均方根偏差从4.48 Å降至1.70 Å，并且随着体系尺寸和对称性重数增加，其优势进一步扩大。因此，SALA能够端到端生成复杂的、受对称性约束的分子晶体，在晶体结构预测、基于结构的药物多晶型设计和有机分子材料发现中具有潜在应用。

items.title: When Does Structured Knowledge Help Neural Theorem Proving?
items.abstract_or_text: Does structured mathematical knowledge help LLMs prove theorems in Lean 4? If so, for which models, and does the answer vary by problem? Formal libraries such as Mathlib encode 285,000+ verified theorems with syntactic dependencies, but the semantic layer mathematicians rely on for discovery (analogies, generalizations, cross-domain bridges) remains implicit. We introduce MathAgent, which builds this layer as a knowledge graph, MathKG, and uses it to augment LLM theorem provers. MathKG connects 364 Mathlib theorems and definitions by 9,434 typed semantic edges inferred via LLM-based relation extraction anchored to verified Mathlib declarations. We run a controlled ablation across four augmentation modes (no context, knowledge-graph context, Mathlib retrieval, both) and five models: Qwen3-8B/32B, their Lean-specialized derivatives Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B, and Claude Sonnet 4.6, on miniF2F, plus PutnamBench and MathOlympiadBench for Sonnet. Three findings emerge. (i) Specialization dominates augmentation: Lean fine-tuning adds 33-38 percentage points of solve rate in every mode, and a specialized 8B model beats a 4\times larger general one by 29-35 points, while no augmentation mode improves solve rate by more than 3 points. (ii) Augmentation is capability-conditioned: knowledge-graph context helps small models but hurts large ones, with the specialized model gaining more relative to its general base at every scale. (iii) Yet the augmentation modes solve different problems: an oracle selecting the best mode per problem solves 6% to 58% more than the unaugmented prover, a complementarity effect that strengthens on harder problems (32% more on PutnamBench). These results motivate adaptive strategies that select augmentation by model capability and problem. Code, data, and artifacts are available at https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent
items.summary_zh: MathAgent 用 MathKG 将 Mathlib 定理和定义的语义关系显式化，并在 Lean 4 定理证明中进行受控消融。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时比较通用模型、Lean 专用模型和多种知识增强方式，报告了可复现实验差异，显示专门化的收益大于单纯增加检索上下文。
items.abstract_zh: 结构化数学知识是否能帮助 LLM 在 Lean 4 中证明定理？如果能帮助，适用于哪些模型，这一答案是否因问题而异？Mathlib 等形式化库编码了 285,000 多个带有句法依赖关系的已验证定理，但数学家用于发现的语义层（类比、推广、跨领域桥接）仍是隐式的。我们提出 MathAgent：它构建这一层语义知识图谱 MathKG，并用其增强 LLM 定理证明器。MathKG 将 364 个 Mathlib 定理和定义连接起来，包含 9,434 条有类型的语义边；这些边通过基于 LLM 的关系抽取推断得到，并锚定在已验证的 Mathlib 声明上。我们在 miniF2F 上对四种增强模式（无上下文、知识图谱上下文、Mathlib 检索、二者结合）和五个模型进行受控消融：Qwen3-8B/32B、其 Lean 专用衍生模型 Goedel-Prover-V2-8B/32B，以及 Claude Sonnet 4.6；对 Sonnet 还使用了 PutnamBench 和 MathOlympiadBench。研究得到三项发现。(i) 专门化胜过增强：在每种模式下，Lean 微调都使求解率提高 33–38 个百分点；专用的 8B 模型比大 4 倍的通用模型高 29–35 个百分点，而任何增强模式带来的求解率提升都不超过 3 个百分点。(ii) 增强效果取决于能力：知识图谱上下文能帮助小模型，却会损害大模型；在每个规模上，专用模型相对于其通用基座模型的相对增益都更大。(iii) 不过，各增强模式解决的问题并不相同：如果由一个 oracle 为每道题选择最佳模式，求解数比未增强证明器多 6% 至 58%；这种互补效应在更难的问题上更强（在 PutnamBench 上多 32%）。这些结果支持根据模型能力和问题选择增强方式的自适应策略。代码、数据和产物见 https://github.com/sarehnabi/mathagent

items.title: An RL View of OPD: Least Square Policy Distillation for Sample-Efficient LLM Reasoning
items.abstract_or_text: We study on-policy distillation (OPD) through the lens of reinforcement learning, establishing a connection between the reverse-KL objective in OPD and KL-regularized policy optimization. Building on this connection, we introduce Least-Square Policy Distillation (LSPD), an RL-inspired framework that brings optimistic exploration and off-policy data reuse from value-based RL into policy distillation. LSPD preserves policy diversity through exploration while improving rollout efficiency by repeatedly learning from previously collected trajectories. Our theoretical analysis connects LSPD to optimistic value-based learning and shows that its idealized formulation achieves a sharp \mathcal O(\log K) regret bound under online exploration. Empirically, LSPD consistently outperforms existing distillation baselines across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and diverse teacher-student settings, with average gains of +1.59 points in Avg@16. Remarkably, through Pass@k evaluations up to k=64, we found that LSPD better preserves policy diversity by achieving stronger performance as k grows. Its fully off-policy variant achieves comparable performance to vanilla OPD using only the first 25% of rollout batches. Together, these results provide an RL perspective on OPD that offers both a principled interpretation and a practical route toward more effective and rollout-efficient language model distillation.

items.abstract_zh: 我们从强化学习的角度研究 on-policy distillation（OPD），建立 OPD 中的 reverse-KL 目标与 KL 正则化策略优化之间的联系。在此基础上，我们提出 Least-Square Policy Distillation（LSPD），这是一个受强化学习启发的框架，将基于价值的强化学习中的乐观探索和离策略数据复用引入策略蒸馏。LSPD 通过探索保持策略多样性，同时通过反复利用先前收集的轨迹进行学习来提高 rollout 效率。我们的理论分析将 LSPD 与乐观的基于价值的学习联系起来，并表明其理想化形式在在线探索下达到尖锐的 O(log K) 遗憾界。在实证方面，在六个数学推理基准和多种教师—学生设置中，LSPD 始终优于现有蒸馏基线，Avg@16 平均提升 +1.59 分。值得注意的是，通过最高 k=64 的 Pass@k 评估，我们发现 LSPD 能更好地保持策略多样性，因为随着 k 增大其性能提升更强。其完全离策略变体只使用前 25% 的 rollout 批次，就达到了与 vanilla OPD 相当的性能。总体而言，这些结果从强化学习视角为 OPD 提供了原理性解释，并为更有效、节省 rollout 的语言模型蒸馏提供了实践路径。

items.title: BEHAVE: Functional Behavior Modeling Enables Self-Improving Agents for Hardware Design and Verification
items.abstract_or_text: Developing agents for hardware design and verification requires reliable correctness feedback. As a hardware specification may permit correct implementations with different latencies, matching design and reference outputs cycle by cycle can reject valid designs. To address this, we introduce BEHAVE, an agentic framework for multi-turn joint hardware design and verification through functional behavior modeling. We define Behavior IR to express task functionality as executable behavior models without prescribing implementation timing beyond the specification. The agent iteratively develops a register-transfer-level (RTL) design and a behavior model as the design's verification reference. Our evaluator, BEHAVE-Sim, checks both artifacts separately against a hidden golden behavior model using input stimuli generated by random sampling and solver-guided search. BEHAVE thus supports power, performance, and area (PPA) exploration across task-permitted latencies and microarchitectures. During training, the same evaluator provides verifiable reinforcement learning (RL) rewards from specification-behavior pairs without reference RTL. For self-improvement, the agent continually searches for high-level implementations relevant to its capability gaps, constructs and checks specification-behavior pairs, and trains on the expanded task pool. We release BEHAVE-Train and BEHAVE-Eval with 600 human-reviewed specification-behavior pairs for realistic hardware workloads. Starting from 60 seed tasks and acquiring 100 new tasks, self-improvement raises Qwen3.8-27B's RTL pass@1 on BEHAVE-Eval from 55.0% to 75.0%, reaching performance comparable to RL using a 540-task pool.
items.summary_zh: BEHAVE 用可执行的 Behavior IR 表示硬件功能，在隐藏 golden behavior model 下分别验证 RTL 与行为模型，并支持可验证强化学习。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 任务允许不同延迟和微架构，避免逐周期匹配误拒绝正确设计；自改进实验把 Qwen3.8-27B 的 RTL pass@1 从 55.0% 提升到 75.0%。
items.abstract_zh: 开发硬件设计与验证 agent 需要可靠的正确性反馈。由于硬件规范可能允许具有不同延迟的正确实现，逐周期匹配设计输出和参考输出可能会拒绝有效设计。为此，我们提出 BEHAVE：一个通过功能行为建模进行多轮联合硬件设计与验证的 agent 框架。我们定义 Behavior IR，用可执行的行为模型表达任务功能，而不对规范允许的实现时序作额外规定。该 agent 迭代开发寄存器传输级（RTL）设计和行为模型，并将后者作为设计的验证参考。我们的评估器 BEHAVE-Sim 在由随机采样和求解器引导搜索生成的输入激励下，分别将这两个产物与隐藏的 golden behavior model 进行检查。因此，BEHAVE 支持在任务允许的延迟和微架构范围内探索功耗、性能和面积（PPA）。在训练期间，同一个评估器无需参考 RTL，即可从规范—行为对中提供可验证的强化学习（RL）奖励。为实现自我改进，该 agent 持续搜索与自身能力缺口相关的高层实现，构造并检查规范—行为对，并在扩展后的任务池上训练。我们发布 BEHAVE-Train 和 BEHAVE-Eval，其中包含 600 个经人工审阅、面向真实硬件工作负载的规范—行为对。从 60 个种子任务出发并获得 100 个新任务后，自我改进使 Qwen3.8-27B 在 BEHAVE-Eval 上的 RTL pass@1 从 55.0% 提升到 75.0%，达到与使用 540 个任务的 RL 相当的性能。

items.title: EHRAdapt: Adapting Pretrained Language Models to Electronic Health Records with Semantic Priors for Rare Clinical Events
items.abstract_or_text: Electronic health records (EHRs) encode clinical histories as (time, modality, code) tuples, whereas pretrained language models expect text tokens. Serializing them as text inflates sequence length and redundantly encodes structure. We introduce EHRAdapt, an adapter that maps tuples directly into a frozen language model's embedding space. Modality receives a learned embedding, time gaps enter through learned attention biases, and event codes receive dedicated vectors. Learning event vectors is the central challenge: clinical vocabularies are long-tailed, leaving rare events too few observations for reliable estimates. EHRAdapt therefore represents each event vector as the sum of a semantic prior and an evidence residual. The prior is a frozen embedding of the event's clinical description from a biomedical language model trained on clinical ontologies, mapped into the model's input space by a shared learned projection, so it supplies clinical meaning even when observations are scarce. The residual, a learned low-rank event-specific correction, refines it as evidence accumulates. We run continued pretraining on about 4 million patients' records with three frozen LLM backbones (OLMo2 1B, Llama3.2 1B, and OLMo2 7B), training only the adapter (0.1--0.6% of all parameters). The full adapter outperforms all ablations in held-out next-event prediction on every backbone. Removing the semantic pathway hurts rare events over ten times more than the most frequent ones, whereas removing the residual hurts overall prediction but improves it for the rarest events. On reportable infectious-disease and syndromic downstream classification tasks, EHRAdapt outperforms text-based LLM and count-based baselines, and both pathways improve rare-disease discrimination. The two pathways therefore play complementary roles, visible only when results are broken down by event frequency rather than averaged.
items.summary_zh: EHRAdapt 将时间、模态和代码元组直接映射到冻结语言模型嵌入空间，在约 4 million 患者记录上仅训练 0.1—0.6% 参数。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 语义先验与证据残差共同处理临床长尾事件，在稀有事件预测和感染病/综合征分类上优于基线；结果来自 preprint，尚非临床部署证据。
items.abstract_zh: 电子健康记录（EHR）将临床病史编码为（时间、模态、代码）元组，而预训练语言模型需要文本 token。将这些元组序列化为文本会增加序列长度，并冗余地编码结构。我们提出 EHRAdapt，一个将元组直接映射到冻结语言模型嵌入空间的 adapter。模态接收一个学习得到的嵌入，时间间隔通过学习得到的 attention bias 输入，事件代码接收专用向量。学习事件向量是核心挑战：临床词汇表具有长尾分布，稀有事件的观测太少，难以获得可靠估计。因此，EHRAdapt 将每个事件向量表示为语义先验与证据残差之和。语义先验是一个 biomedical language model 对事件临床描述的冻结嵌入；该模型在临床本体上训练，并通过共享的学习投影映射到目标模型的输入空间，因此即使观测稀少，也能提供临床语义。残差是一个学习得到的低秩、事件特异性修正，用于随着证据积累进行细化。我们在约 4 million 患者的记录上进行 continued pretraining，使用三个冻结的 LLM backbone（OLMo2 1B、Llama3.2 1B 和 OLMo2 7B），仅训练 adapter，占全部参数的 0.1--0.6%。在每个 backbone 上，完整 adapter 在保留的 next-event prediction 任务中都优于所有消融版本。去除语义通路对稀有事件的影响比对最高频事件的影响大十倍以上，而去除残差会损害总体预测，却能改善最稀有事件的预测。在可报告传染病和综合征的下游分类任务中，EHRAdapt 优于基于文本的 LLM 和基于计数的基线，两条通路都改善了罕见疾病判别。因此，只有在按事件频率拆分结果、而不是取平均时，才能观察到两条通路的互补作用。

items.title: Zero-Storage Procedural Neural Synthesis via Boundary Dynamics: Formal Verification in Lean 4 and Bare-Metal Gauntlet Validation
items.abstract_or_text: Contemporary neural inference architectures rely on dense floating-point weight matrices stored in high-bandwidth memory (VRAM), incurring severe memory-wall bottlenecks and preventing native execution inside deterministic virtual machines like the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). Verifying termination and arithmetic invariants for recursive dynamical systems over continuous domains is generally undecidable in the Blum-Shub-Smale model. Here, we present the formal verification and bare-metal empirical validation of WERR (Waves & Errors) and Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics (OED), a non-tensor decision paradigm that procedurally synthesizes non-linear decision boundaries on demand from a 24-byte coordinate seed Θ= (c_x, c_y, zoom) along the boundary of the Mandelbrot set (\partialM). By projecting the recurrence z_{n+1} = z_n^2 + c onto the modular residue ring Z/9Z and the fixed-point domain Q_{16.16}, we establish ten machine-verified theorems in Lean 4 (v4.34.1) with Mathlib4 and zero unproven conjectures (sorry): proving I_3 = \{0,3,6\} \subset Z/9Z ideal closure, universal fuel-bounded halting (\le 9 and \le 12 steps), absence of Q_{16.16} square overflow below 2^{63}-1, non-constant boundary escape sensitivity, and a parametric EVM gas bound (\le 22,557 \le 24,000 gas). Evaluated on a 40-core Dual Intel Xeon server, the vectorized 36-iteration CPU kernel processes 100,000 decisions in 6.49 s (15,397 decisions/s, 0 Bytes VRAM, 15.15x speedup), while a sigmoidal outlier gate suppresses 100.00% of adversarial spikes while preserving 89.60% of clean baseline signals.
items.summary_zh: 该工作在 Lean 4/Mathlib4 中形式验证 WERR 与 Phase III OED 的算术不变量、终止性和 EVM gas 上界，并进行裸机性能验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 摘要明确列出十个无 sorry 的机器核验定理及其边界条件，同时报告吞吐、显存和对抗尖峰抑制结果，便于复核形式化与实测两部分。
items.abstract_zh: 当代神经推理架构依赖存储在高带宽内存（VRAM）中的稠密浮点权重矩阵，从而产生严重的内存墙瓶颈，并阻碍其在以太坊虚拟机（EVM）等确定性虚拟机中原生执行。在 Blum-Shub-Smale 模型中，验证连续域上递归动力系统的终止性和算术不变量通常是不可判定的。这里我们展示 WERR（Waves & Errors）和 Phase III Orbital Error Dynamics（OED）的形式验证与裸机实证验证。这是一种非张量决策范式，可根据 Mandelbrot 集边界 ∂M 上的 24 字节坐标种子 Θ=(c_x,c_y,zoom) 按需程序化合成非线性决策边界。我们把递推 z_{n+1}=z_n^2+c 投影到模剩余环 Z/9Z 和定点域 Q_{16.16} 上，使用 Lean 4（v4.34.1）与 Mathlib4 建立了十个机器验证定理，并且没有未证明的猜想（sorry）：证明 I_3={0,3,6} 是 Z/9Z 的理想闭包、通用的燃料有界停机（≤9 步和 ≤12 步）、在 2^63−1 以下不存在 Q_{16.16} 平方溢出、边界逃逸敏感性不是常数，以及参数化 EVM gas 上界（≤22,557≤24,000 gas）。在一台 40 核 Dual Intel Xeon 服务器上评估时，向量化的 36 次迭代 CPU 内核在 6.49 秒内处理 100,000 次决策（15,397 次决策/秒、0 Bytes VRAM、15.15 倍加速）；同时，sigmoidal outlier gate 抑制了 100.00% 的对抗尖峰，并保留 89.60% 的干净基线信号。

items.title: Validating Memory-Optimal Transformer Kernels on Real Hardware: From Formal Derivation to Measured Performance Across Two HPC Clusters
items.abstract_or_text: We validate memory-optimal cost functions for transformer kernels derived via the Mathematics of Arrays (MoA). Companion Papers I-IV formally derive kernels for attention forward, backward, fused forward+backward, decode, and the complete block (RMSNorm, gated MLP) as a hardware-independent specification (DNF) transformed to a machine-specific realization (ONF) via gamma, with verification to machine precision against PyTorch. This paper checks those predictions against measured performance on two HPC clusters (Purdue Anvil, NCSA Delta) across CPU and GPU. Three results stand out. (1) We identify and fix a GPU regression: fusing forward+backward, proven to avoid materializing an O(n^2) intermediate, initially ran slower than naive on GPU due to atomic contention. Profiling confirmed 2.00x more atomic instructions; a targeted ONF rewrite reversed it, yielding up to 2.5x speedup. (2) Identical derivations produce markedly different real costs by topology: 535x NUMA-locality penalty on one cluster vs <3x oversubscription on another, showing optimal deployment is a function of the machine's array structure. (3) We report a partially resolved anomaly: identical denotational computations run faster in C than Fortran on CPU but faster in Fortran than C on GPU, narrowed to one dominant kernel and one memory-latency stall mechanism (3.17x time gap matches 3.35x stall gap). We treat hardware-specific optimization as a routine ONF rewrite with fixed, verified DNF, a candidate methodology for scaling AI onto evolving hardware without re-deriving correctness.
items.summary_zh: 论文把 Mathematics of Arrays 推导出的 Transformer 内存最优成本函数与两座 HPC 集群的 CPU/GPU 实测连接起来，并分析形式推导到机器实现的偏差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 除机器精度验证外，还定位 GPU 原子竞争回归并修复，展示形式化成本模型如何指导可复核的硬件优化。
items.abstract_zh: 我们验证通过 Mathematics of Arrays（MoA）推导出的 Transformer 内核内存最优成本函数。配套的论文 I–IV 将 attention forward、backward、fused forward+backward、decode 以及完整模块（RMSNorm、gated MLP）形式化推导为与硬件无关的规范（DNF），再通过 gamma 转换为特定机器的实现（ONF），并与 PyTorch 进行机器精度级验证。本文在两个 HPC 集群（Purdue Anvil、NCSA Delta）的 CPU 和 GPU 上，通过测量性能检查这些预测。三个结果尤为突出。(1) 我们发现并修复了一个 GPU 回归：已证明能避免物化 O(n^2) 中间结果的 fused forward+backward，在 GPU 上最初却因原子竞争而慢于朴素实现。性能分析确认原子指令多出 2.00 倍；有针对性的 ONF 重写扭转了这一结果，最高带来 2.5 倍加速。(2) 相同推导在不同拓扑上产生显著不同的真实成本：一个集群出现 535 倍的 NUMA 局部性惩罚，而另一个集群的过量订阅低于 3 倍，说明最优部署取决于机器的数组结构。(3) 我们报告了一个部分解决的异常：相同的指称计算在 CPU 上 C 比 Fortran 更快，但在 GPU 上 Fortran 比 C 更快；该异常已缩小到一个主导内核和一种内存延迟停顿机制（3.17 倍的时间差与 3.35 倍的停顿差相匹配）。我们把硬件特定优化视为一种常规 ONF 重写：固定且已验证的 DNF 不变；这是一种候选方法，可在不断变化的硬件上扩展 AI，而无需重新推导正确性。

items.title: GraPPI: A Self-Supervised Graph Encoder for Transferable Protein--Protein Interaction Modeling
items.abstract_or_text: Protein--Protein Interactions (PPIs) are fundamental to cellular processes and represent major targets for therapeutic development. Recent advances in machine learning for protein modeling, particularly protein language models, have enabled powerful representations of protein sequences and monomeric structures. However, compared with the increasingly generalizable representations available for individual proteins, transferable representations explicitly designed to capture protein-complex and interface contexts remain less developed. Here, we developed GraPPI, a unified graph-based deep learning framework for learning transferable representations of protein--protein complexes. At its core, PPIencoder represents protein complexes as heterogeneous residual graphs and uses self-supervised masked-edge prediction to learn interaction-aware representations that integrate sequence, three-dimensional geometry, and physicochemical properties. We then evaluated the transferability of these pretrained representations across complementary PPI tasks spanning binding-mode classification, binding-affinity prediction, and mutation-associated affinity prediction. GraPPI accurately distinguished plausible binding interfaces from perturbed or decoy binding interfaces, achieving AUROC values above 0.92 on an independent benchmark. For protein--protein binding-affinity prediction, GraPPI achieved Pearson correlation coefficients of 0.690 and 0.684 on the S90 and S79 benchmarks, respectively, with performance competitive with or exceeding that of recently reported affinity-prediction methods. GraPPI further transferred effectively to mutation-associated binding-affinity prediction, achieving a Pearson correlation of 0.84 and a mean absolute error of 1.20 kcal/mol on an independent SKEMPI benchmark. Together, these results establish GraPPI as a generalizable framework for protein-complex representation learning, extending pretrained protein representations from individual proteins toward the interaction context in which protein function is realized.
items.summary_zh: GraPPI将蛋白复合物表示为异质残差图，通过自监督掩码边预测联合学习序列、三维几何和物化性质；在界面分类、结合亲和力和突变亲和力任务上迁移，在独立基准上AUROC超过0.92，并在SKEMPI上取得Pearson 0.84、MAE 1.20 kcal/mol。

items.abstract_zh: 蛋白质—蛋白质相互作用（PPI）是细胞过程的基础，也是治疗开发的重要靶点。近期蛋白质建模，尤其是蛋白质语言模型的进展，已经为蛋白质序列和单体结构带来了强大的表示。然而，与日益具有通用性的单个蛋白质表示相比，明确设计用于捕获蛋白质复合物和界面上下文的可迁移表示仍然较少。在这里，我们开发了GraPPI，这是一个用于学习蛋白质—蛋白质复合物可迁移表示的统一图深度学习框架。其核心PPIencoder将蛋白质复合物表示为异质残差图，并使用自监督掩码边预测来学习具有相互作用意识的表示，整合序列、三维几何和物化性质。随后，我们在互补的PPI任务中评估这些预训练表示的可迁移性，包括结合模式分类、结合亲和力预测和突变相关亲和力预测。GraPPI能够准确区分合理的结合界面与扰动或诱饵结合界面，在独立基准上的AUROC值超过0.92。对于蛋白质—蛋白质结合亲和力预测，GraPPI在S90和S79基准上的Pearson相关系数分别为0.690和0.684，性能可与近期报道的亲和力预测方法竞争或超过它们。GraPPI还有效迁移到突变相关结合亲和力预测，在独立SKEMPI基准上取得Pearson相关系数0.84和1.20 kcal/mol的平均绝对误差。总体而言，这些结果确立了GraPPI作为蛋白质复合物表示学习的通用框架，将预训练蛋白质表示从单个蛋白质扩展到蛋白质功能得以实现的相互作用上下文。

items.title: EpiZoo: a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics
items.abstract_or_text: Large-scale single-cell epigenomic atlases characterize chromatin regulatory landscapes across diverse biological contexts, spanning cell types, tissues, individuals and species. Foundation models provide an opportunity to capture the full spectrum of cellular diversity in these atlases, yet current models remain largely confined to individual species by genomic coordinate dependence and overlook regulatory information encoded in DNA sequences. Here we introduce EpiZoo, a DNA sequence-aware foundation model for cross-species single-cell epigenomics. EpiZoo converts million-dimensional single-cell epigenomic profiles from diverse species into compact cell sentences that integrate DNA-encoded regulatory information, sequence-independent epigenomic context and accessibility-based importance. Built around a mixture-of-experts transformer and containing 2.6 billion parameters in total, EpiZoo is pretrained on our manually curated multi-species Omni-scATAC corpus of approximately 20.9 million cells to learn regulatory programs across species. On external datasets excluded from pretraining, EpiZoo achieves state-of-the-art performance in fundamental single-cell analysis tasks, including feature extraction, cell type annotation and data imputation. Its sequence-aware architecture enables extension to evolutionarily diverse species, and supports comparative analysis of regulatory conservation and divergence during primate evolution. Benefiting from this modeling design, EpiZoo enables context-aware prioritization of somatic mutations in cancer and prediction of cell-type-specific chromatin accessibility from DNA sequences across genomic regions and species.
items.summary_zh: EpiZoo 是一个面向跨物种单细胞表观基因组学、结合 DNA 序列信息的 foundation model，在约 20.9 million cells 上预训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 2.6 billion 参数和跨物种外部数据评估使其具有较大规模；结果支持调控保守性、分化和癌症体细胞突变优先级研究，但仍需独立复现。
items.abstract_zh: 大规模单细胞表观基因组图谱刻画了跨越细胞类型、组织、个体和物种的多种生物学背景下的染色质调控景观。Foundation model 提供了捕获这些图谱中完整细胞多样性的机会，但现有模型大多由于依赖基因组坐标而局限于单一物种，并忽略了 DNA 序列中编码的调控信息。我们在此介绍 EpiZoo，一个面向跨物种单细胞表观基因组学、能够感知 DNA 序列的 foundation model。EpiZoo 将来自不同物种的 million-dimensional 单细胞表观基因组谱转换为紧凑的 cell sentences，整合 DNA 编码的调控信息、与序列无关的表观基因组背景以及基于可及性的权重。EpiZoo 以 mixture-of-experts transformer 为核心，总参数量为 2.6 billion，在我们人工整理的多物种 Omni-scATAC corpus（约 20.9 million cells）上进行预训练，以学习跨物种的调控程序。在排除于预训练之外的外部数据集上，EpiZoo 在特征提取、细胞类型注释和数据插补等基础单细胞分析任务中取得了 state-of-the-art 性能。其序列感知架构可以扩展到进化上多样的物种，并支持比较灵长类进化过程中的调控保守性与分化。得益于这种建模设计，EpiZoo 可以对癌症中的体细胞突变进行背景感知的优先级排序，并从跨基因组区域和物种的 DNA 序列预测细胞类型特异性的染色质可及性。

items.title: TxCyto: A machine learning framework for estimating cytokine activity from whole transcriptome
items.abstract_or_text: Cytokines are critical mediators of intercellular communication, and a comprehensive characterization of their activity is essential for understanding health and disease. Existing tools to infer cytokine activity rely on experimental measurements. However, such measurements are available only for a small minority (43) of cytokines, and moreover, cytokine activity and response are highly context-specific, making a comprehensive experimental profiling across tissues, disease states, and biological contexts impractical. To address this gap, we developed TxCyto - a deep learning-based framework that infers the activity of cytokines, and more broadly of the tumor secretome, directly from the whole transcriptome profile of a sample. Trained on pan-cancer TCGA tumor transcriptomes, TxCyto was extensively validated in multiple independent datasets, including cytokine perturbation experiments. Across multiple cancer immunotherapy cohorts, TxCyto identified cytokines whose predicted activity was associated with therapeutic response. Furthermore, in spatial transcriptomic data for Liver cancer, TxCyto discovered spatial niches associated with response to immunotherapy. Overall, we develop a machine learning tool -TxCyto, for predicting the activity of 645 cytokines and tumor secretome from readily available whole transcriptomes. The TxCyto framework is generally applicable to other classes of regulatory molecules and TxCyto code base, and the tools are provided at https://github.com/Rahulncbs/TxCyto.
items.summary_zh: TxCyto 从 whole transcriptome 推断 645 种 cytokines 及 tumor secretome 活性，并在多种独立数据集、扰动实验和癌症免疫治疗队列中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把难以全面实验测量的 cytokine activity 转化为可从转录组估计的信号，并与治疗反应和空间免疫治疗生态位相关联；这些关联不等于因果作用。
items.abstract_zh: 细胞因子是细胞间通信的重要介质，全面表征其活性对于理解健康和疾病至关重要。现有用于推断细胞因子活性的工具依赖实验测量。然而，只有少数细胞因子（43 种）具有这类测量，而且细胞因子活性和反应高度依赖具体背景，因此不可能在组织、疾病状态和生物学背景的广泛范围内进行全面实验分析。为解决这一空缺，我们开发了 TxCyto——一个基于深度学习的框架，可直接从样本的 whole transcriptome profile 推断细胞因子活性，并进一步推断 tumor secretome 活性。TxCyto 在 pan-cancer TCGA tumor transcriptomes 上训练，并在多个独立数据集中进行了广泛验证，其中包括细胞因子扰动实验。在多个癌症免疫治疗队列中，TxCyto 识别出其预测活性与治疗反应相关的细胞因子。此外，在 Liver cancer 的空间转录组数据中，TxCyto 发现了与免疫治疗反应相关的空间生态位。总体而言，我们开发了机器学习工具 TxCyto，可从容易获得的 whole transcriptomes 预测 645 种细胞因子和 tumor secretome 的活性。TxCyto 框架通常也适用于其他调控分子类别，TxCyto code base 和工具已在 https://github.com/Rahulncbs/TxCyto 提供。

items.title: Inferring cascade drivers of VEXAS syndrome by a causal machine learning tool CauNagi
items.abstract_or_text: VEXAS syndrome is an adult-onset severe autoinflammatory disease caused by somatic mutations in UBA1, yet the cascade mechanisms linking primitive hematopoietic abnormalities to mature myeloid dysfunctions remain largely unknown. Identifying master regulators of a progressive disease, a black-box process, from complex transcriptomic data also remains challenging. To address this challenge, we developed CauNagi, a computational framework for prioritizing cascade candidate regulators (CCRs). CauNagi integrates a causal representation learning module derived from CausCell with an iterative deep learning backbone adapted from UNAGI; in addition, CauNagi extends these two components with a unique downstream module for CCRs analysis designed to characterize regulatory propagation across hierarchical cellular states. Mechanistically, CauNagi iteratively integrates causal disentangled representation learning with (1) disease-stage cell-state trajectory reconstruction and (2) dynamic regulatory analysis. Benchmarking on single-cell transcriptomic datasets showed that CauNagi preserved cell-type structure in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) and enriched known acute myeloid leukemia(AML)-associated genes among its top-ranked global regulators. When applied to VEXAS syndrome, CauNagi readily revealed inflammatory responses, endoplasmic reticulum stress, and myeloid bias, consistent with the disease features. Furthermore, the CCRs analysis module of CauNagi assisted us in identifying 36 causal drivers, with SPI1, NFKB1, STAT3, and FOS prioritized as high-confidence regulatory hubs linking aberrant myeloid differentiation and inflammatory programs. These findings were further supported by an independent single-cell transcriptomic dataset from a murine VEXAS model. Overall, CauNagi provides a computationally efficient and systematic framework for identifying candidate causal regulators. Beyond hematopoietic diseases, CauNagi may also be applicable to other progressive disorders for which multistage single-cell transcriptomic datasets are available. CauNagi is available at https://github.com/steamed-stuffed-bun/CauNagi.
items.summary_zh: CauNagi 将 causal representation learning、迭代深度学习和阶段性调控传播分析结合，用于从单细胞转录组中优先筛选 VEXAS syndrome 的 cascade candidate regulators。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 VEXAS syndrome 中提出 36 个候选因果驱动因子，并由独立小鼠数据支持 SPI1、NFKB1、STAT3 和 FOS 等调控枢纽；这些仍是候选机制而非已证实因果关系。
items.abstract_zh: VEXAS syndrome 是一种成年起病的严重自身炎症性疾病，由 UBA1 的体细胞突变引起，但从原始造血异常到成熟髓系功能障碍之间的级联机制仍大体未知。从复杂转录组数据中识别进行性疾病的主调控因子这一黑箱过程，同样具有挑战性。为解决这一问题，我们开发了 CauNagi，一个用于优先筛选 cascade candidate regulators（CCRs）的计算框架。CauNagi 整合了源自 CausCell 的 causal representation learning 模块和改编自 UNAGI 的迭代深度学习骨干；此外，CauNagi 还加入了一个独特的下游 CCRs 分析模块，用于刻画层级细胞状态之间的调控传播。在机制上，CauNagi 迭代整合因果解耦表征学习与以下两类过程：（1）疾病阶段的细胞状态轨迹重建；（2）动态调控分析。在单细胞转录组数据集上的基准测试显示，CauNagi 保留了 idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis（IPF）的细胞类型结构，并在其排名靠前的全局调控因子中富集了已知的 acute myeloid leukemia（AML）相关基因。当应用于 VEXAS syndrome 时，CauNagi 识别出与疾病特征一致的炎症反应、内质网应激和髓系偏向。此外，CCRs 分析模块帮助我们识别出 36 个因果驱动因子，其中 SPI1、NFKB1、STAT3 和 FOS 被优先列为高置信度调控枢纽，连接异常髓系分化与炎症程序。这些发现还得到独立 VEXAS 小鼠模型单细胞转录组数据集的支持。总体而言，CauNagi 提供了一个计算高效且系统的方法，用于识别候选因果调控因子。除造血系统疾病外，对于具有多阶段单细胞转录组数据的其他进行性疾病，CauNagi 也可能适用。CauNagi 可在 https://github.com/steamed-stuffed-bun/CauNagi 获取。
