items.title: One Sequence, Many Decodings: CAGenMol-2 Recasts Drug Design as Masked Molecular Inference
items.abstract_or_text: Drug design couples property evaluation, conditional generation, structure-based design, and local optimization, yet machine learning systems typically address these capabilities with separate task-specific models. We introduce CAGenMol-2, a masked diffusion molecular language model that represents molecules, continuous scalar properties, and 3D protein pockets within a single wrapped sequence. Within this pretrained interface, downstream operations are selected by which sequence regions are observed or masked at inference, allowing one checkpoint to perform property prediction, property- and pocket-conditioned generation, and partial-constraint design without task-specific architectures or backbone fine-tuning. We further propose Adaptive Fragment Optimization (AdaFO), a gradient-free mask-and-refill search that turns the masked decoder into an iterative local molecular optimizer. On CrossDocked2020, AdaFO increases Success Rate from 30.2\% to 70.8\%, the best reported under this protocol, while largely preserving drug-likeness and diversity. Finally, scaffold-preserving directional editing and CRBN/VHL case studies demonstrate its use in compound design workflows spanning local molecular editing, structure-based prioritization, and downstream simulation-based screening.
items.summary_zh: CAGenMol-2以统一的掩码扩散分子语言模型表示分子、连续性质和3D蛋白口袋，并通过推理时的掩码区域选择执行性质预测、条件生成和局部编辑；AdaFO在CrossDocked2020上将Success Rate从30.2%提高到70.8%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 统一接口减少了药物设计中多任务、多模型拼接的复杂性，且局部优化结果有明确基准提升。限制是结果主要依赖CrossDocked2020和模拟筛选，真实合成、活性与药代验证尚未体现。
items.abstract_zh: 药物设计同时涉及性质评估、条件生成、基于结构的设计和局部优化，但机器学习系统通常使用针对不同任务的独立模型。我们提出CAGenMol-2，这是一种掩码扩散分子语言模型，在单一封装序列中表示分子、连续标量性质和3D蛋白口袋。在这一预训练接口中，下游操作由推理时哪些序列区域被观察或被掩码来选择，使同一个检查点能够执行性质预测、性质和口袋条件生成，以及无需任务专用架构或骨干网络微调的部分约束设计。我们进一步提出自适应片段优化（Adaptive Fragment Optimization，AdaFO），这是一种无梯度的掩码—填充搜索方法，可将掩码解码器转化为迭代式局部分子优化器。在CrossDocked2020上，AdaFO将Success Rate从30.2%提高到70.8%，在该协议下达到已报告的最佳水平，同时基本保持药物相似性和多样性。最后，保留支架的定向编辑以及CRBN/VHL案例研究展示了其在化合物设计流程中的用途，涵盖局部分子编辑、基于结构的优先级排序和下游基于模拟的筛选。
items.author_line: Yanting Li, Enyan Dai, Lei Wang, Wen-Cai Ye, Li Liu

items.title: Tri-Modality Representation Learning for Molecular Property Prediction
items.abstract_or_text: Accurate molecular property prediction requires effective molecular representations that can describe a molecule from multiple complementary perspectives. Existing deep learning approaches typically use SMILES strings, two-dimensional molecular graphs, or three-dimensional conformations as inputs. These representations capture different aspects of molecular information: SMILES encodes a sequential description, molecular graphs describe atom-bond connectivity, and 3D conformations provide spatial information from atomic coordinates. However, these modalities are often learned separately or merged with low effective fusion operations, which may not sufficiently capture interactions among sequential, topological, and geometric features. In this work, we propose Tri-Modality Cross-Attention (TMCA), a multimodal framework that integrates 1D SMILES, 2D molecular graphs, and 3D molecular conformations for molecular property prediction. TMCA uses pretrained encoders for the 1D and 3D branches, with a SMILES-based Transformer for the 1D branch and a recent conformation-aware pretrained model for the 3D branch. At the same time, a trainable 2D graph encoder is designed to support modality fusion. All the parameters from the pretrained models are frozen to make overall training more efficient. We evaluate TMCA on four datasets (i.e., BBBP, BACE, ClinTox, and HIV) from the MoleculeNet database for classification tasks and compare its performance with state-of-the-art competing approaches. Experimental results show that TMCA achieves the best overall performance, demonstrating the value of multi-modality integration for drug property prediction and the effectiveness of our cross-attention-based fusion strategy. The source code of TMCA is available at: https://github.com/Ay-Zhao/TMCA
items.summary_zh: TMCA冻结预训练的1D SMILES和3D构象编码器，配合可训练的2D图编码器，通过跨注意力融合三种分子表示；在MoleculeNet的BBBP、BACE、ClinTox和HIV分类数据集上取得总体最佳表现。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以明确的1D/2D/3D互补信息融合改进药物性质预测，并兼顾训练效率。限制是评测数据集规模和任务类型有限，摘要未给出与基线的具体数值或外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 准确预测分子性质需要有效的分子表示，以便从多个互补视角描述分子。现有深度学习方法通常将SMILES字符串、二维分子图或三维构象作为输入。这些表示捕获分子信息的不同方面：SMILES编码序列描述，分子图描述原子—键连接关系，3D构象提供原子坐标的空间信息。然而，这些模态通常被分别学习，或通过有效性较低的融合操作合并，因而可能无法充分捕获序列、拓扑和几何特征之间的相互作用。在本研究中，我们提出三模态交叉注意力（Tri-Modality Cross-Attention，TMCA），这是一个整合1D SMILES、2D分子图和3D分子构象的分子性质预测多模态框架。TMCA对1D和3D分支使用预训练编码器：1D分支采用基于SMILES的Transformer，3D分支采用近期的构象感知预训练模型。同时，设计了一个可训练的2D图编码器以支持模态融合。预训练模型的全部参数都被冻结，使整体训练更加高效。我们在MoleculeNet数据库中的4个数据集（即BBBP、BACE、ClinTox和HIV）上评估TMCA的分类任务表现，并与最先进的竞争方法比较。实验结果显示，TMCA取得总体最佳性能，证明了多模态整合对药物性质预测的价值，以及基于交叉注意力的融合策略的有效性。TMCA的源代码可见：https://github.com/Ay-Zhao/TMCA
items.author_line: zhao, A., Li, J.

items.title: M3OS: A Monte Carlo Graph Search-Orchestrated Multi-Agent LLM System for Evidence-Traced Molecular Optimization
items.abstract_or_text: Small-molecule optimization integrates medicinal-chemistry reasoning and computational evidence through iterative, multi-objective decisions. When large language models (LLMs) reason over optimization histories stored primarily in conversational context, they must recover candidate identities, prior evaluations, and task constraints to guide subsequent decisions. We present M3OS, a multi-agent LLM system that decouples molecular-design reasoning from optimization-state management through Monte Carlo graph search. A persistent graph links evaluated candidates, parent-child transformations and evaluation evidence, while rewards and visit statistics guide LLM-assisted parent selection. Two branches combine tool-driven candidate generation with knowledge- and case-guided medicinal-chemistry editing. An execution harness controls graph updates through structured output extraction, molecular validation and task-bound evaluation. Agents receive role-specific contexts, while the graph preserves optimization trajectories beyond their active contexts. Across three molecular optimization benchmarks, M3OS achieves higher success rates than baselines, supporting the integration of persistent search state, specialized agents and controlled execution for multi-constraint optimization.
items.summary_zh: M3OS用持久化分子图保存候选物、父子变换和评估证据，以蒙特卡洛图搜索指导LLM选择分子母体，并结合工具驱动生成、知识引导和案例引导的药化编辑；在3个分子优化基准上成功率高于基线。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它解决了LLM依赖会话上下文保存优化历史的问题，将搜索状态、分子验证和多目标决策显式化。限制是摘要未报告具体提升幅度，且基准成功率不等同于实验合成与活性验证。
items.abstract_zh: 小分子优化通过迭代式多目标决策，将药物化学推理与计算证据结合起来。当大型语言模型（LLM）主要在对话上下文中对优化历史进行推理时，它们必须恢复候选物身份、先前评估结果和任务约束，以指导后续决策。我们提出M3OS，这是一种多智能体LLM系统，通过蒙特卡洛图搜索将分子设计推理与优化状态管理解耦。持久化图连接已评估候选物、父子变换和评估证据，奖励与访问统计量指导LLM辅助的母体选择。两个分支分别结合工具驱动的候选生成，以及知识和案例引导的药物化学编辑。执行框架通过结构化输出提取、分子验证和任务边界评估控制图更新。智能体接收角色专属上下文，而图则在其活动上下文之外保存优化轨迹。在3个分子优化基准上，M3OS取得高于基线的成功率，支持将持久化搜索状态、专门化智能体和受控执行结合用于多约束优化。
items.author_line: Junjie Wang, Yaowei Jin, Ruohui Tang, Guonan Cui, Haojie Wang, Penglei Wang, Dingyan Wang, Duo An, Shuangjia Zheng, Qian Shi

items.title: Native implementation of the machine-learned Skala exchange-correlation functional in CP2K: Unified one-centre reconstruction for molecular and condensed-phase calculations
items.abstract_or_text: We implement the machine-learned Skala exchange-correlation (XC) functional natively in CP2K using its Gaussian and plane-wave (GPW) and Gaussian and augmented-plane-wave (GAPW) methods. A joint one-centre reconstruction of density, density gradients, and kinetic-energy density before functional evaluation preserves mixed gradient terms and nonlocal couplings between smooth and atom-local contributions in all-electron and pseudopotential calculations. An XC-specific GAPW representation resolves rapidly varying local contributions on atom-centred grids, reducing plane-wave requirements for pseudopotential calculations. The implementation includes Brillouin-zone sampling and point-group symmetry reduction. With sufficiently flexible orbital bases, it retains the molecular benchmark accuracy of our earlier GauXC formulation. All-electron Skala-D3(BJ) calculations yield a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.54 kJ mol^{-1} against diffusion Monte Carlo for crystalline CO_2, NH_3, and urea, spanning dispersion, quadrupolar electrostatics, and hydrogen bonding. For all thirteen DMC-ICE13 phases, the MAEs are 1.16 kJ mol^{-1} for absolute lattice energies and 0.82 kJ mol^{-1} for the twelve relative energies to ice Ih. At fixed experimental geometries, all-electron/mixed-core calculations give a band-gap MAE of 0.43 eV on a 15-material set, substantially below commonly used semilocal functionals and comparable to widely used hybrid functionals. The LC10 benchmark nevertheless reveals systematically underestimated equilibrium lattice constants, indicating structural overbinding. This framework connects molecular Skala to condensed-phase electronic structure and enables future development using periodic many-body reference data.
items.summary_zh: 研究者将机器学习Skala交换-相关泛函原生实现于CP2K，通过统一单中心重构处理分子和凝聚相计算；在DMC-ICE13晶相上获得1.16 kJ mol−1的绝对晶格能MAE、0.82 kJ mol−1的相对能MAE，在15种材料上带隙MAE为0.43 eV，但LC10显示晶格常数系统性偏小。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该实现把机器学习泛函从分子扩展到周期体系，并以扩散蒙特卡洛等高水平参考数据验证。限制是仍存在结构过度结合，且结果依赖基组、参考体系和实验几何条件。
items.abstract_zh: 我们使用高斯与平面波（GPW）以及高斯与增强平面波（GAPW）方法，将机器学习Skala交换—相关（XC）泛函原生实现于CP2K。在泛函评估之前，对密度、密度梯度和动能密度进行联合单中心重构，从而在全电子和赝势计算中保留混合梯度项以及平滑贡献和原子局域贡献之间的非局域耦合。针对XC的GAPW表示在以原子为中心的网格上解析快速变化的局域贡献，降低了赝势计算对平面波的要求。该实现包括布里渊区采样和点群对称性约化。在足够灵活的轨道基组下，它保持了我们先前GauXC实现的分子基准精度。全电子Skala-D3(BJ)计算针对晶体CO2、NH3和尿素，以扩散蒙特卡洛为参照得到1.54 kJ mol−1的平均绝对误差（MAE），覆盖色散、四极静电和氢键作用。对于全部13个DMC-ICE13相，绝对晶格能的MAE为1.16 kJ mol−1，相对于冰Ih的12个相对能的MAE为0.82 kJ mol−1。在固定实验几何下，全电子/混合芯计算在15种材料上的带隙MAE为0.43 eV，显著低于常用半局域泛函，并与广泛使用的杂化泛函相当。然而，LC10基准显示平衡晶格常数存在系统性低估，表明结构过度结合。该框架将分子Skala与凝聚相电子结构连接起来，并支持未来利用周期性多体参考数据进行开发。
items.author_line: Johann Pototschnig, Franz Pöschel, Jürg Hutter, Thomas D. Kühne

items.title: Continuous Variational Synthesis
items.abstract_or_text: Biological machine learning was long bottlenecked by the ability to synthesize designed DNA. Variational synthesis models control chemical reactions to physically manufacture quadrillions of designed sequences in DNA. However, training these generative models is challenging: constraints on chemical synthesis can force many parameters into a discrete space, limiting the ability to pre-train and fine-tune. In this article we train ``free'' variational synthesis models using stochastic gradient descent in continuous space, and then discretize with post-training quantization to impose hardware and wetware constraints. This enables variational synthesis models to satisfy stringent reward criteria, while still synthesizing diverse designs, achieving a strictly dominating quality-diversity Pareto frontier. We demonstrate by training variational synthesis models of enzymes, peptides, antibody CDRH3s, and regulatory DNA elements. In silico performance is maintained in vitro.
items.summary_zh: 该工作在连续空间中用随机梯度下降训练“自由”的变分合成模型，再通过后训练量化施加化学合成、硬件和湿实验约束；模型覆盖酶、肽、抗体CDRH3和调控DNA，获得严格支配的质量—多样性Pareto前沿，且计算表现可在体外保持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把可合成性约束从训练阶段部分移到后训练量化，扩大了序列生成模型的优化空间，并连接计算设计与体外合成。限制是摘要未给出具体产率、序列规模和体外实验数量，实际化学合成成本仍需评估。
items.abstract_zh: 长期以来，生物机器学习受到设计DNA合成能力的限制。变分合成模型控制化学反应，在物理上制造数以万亿计的设计序列。然而，训练这些生成模型具有挑战性：化学合成约束会迫使许多参数进入离散空间，从而限制预训练和微调。在本文中，我们使用随机梯度下降在连续空间中训练“自由”的变分合成模型，然后通过后训练量化进行离散化，以施加硬件和湿实验约束。这使变分合成模型在仍能合成多样化设计的同时满足严格的奖励标准，并获得严格支配的质量—多样性Pareto前沿。我们展示了对酶、肽、抗体CDRH3和调控DNA训练变分合成模型。在计算机内的性能能够在体外保持。
items.author_line: Alan N. Amin, Mattia G. Gollub, Andrei Slabodkin, Elizabeth B. Wood, Eli N. Weinstein

items.title: Physics-Guided Conditional Diffusion Model for Rare Event Synthesis and Diagnosis for the Water-Gas Shift Reaction
items.abstract_or_text: As the world moves towards sustainable energy sources, hydrogen (H2) can be treated as an eco-friendly alternative to fossil fuels due to its high energy density and zero carbon emissions. The water-gas shift (WGS) reaction is a widely used industrial process for hydrogen production by converting carbon monoxide and steam into hydrogen and carbon dioxide. However, occurrences like severe fouling, catalyst deterioration, and thermal runaway can hamper the reaction kinetics/process safety and decrease the yield of H2. These incidents are rare, and gathering process data under such abnormal conditions is challenging. In this work, we propose a physics-guided conditional diffusion model to generate realistic rare-event trajectories for the WGS reaction. The proposed model integrates a conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (CDDPM) with governing laws of the reaction to generate physically consistent process trajectories. The conditioning features allow the model to produce high-quality synthetic profiles for rare-event domains that are typically beyond the training regimes. The generated rare-event trajectories then augment the raw dataset for a balanced distribution between normal and abnormal conditions. We further propose a hazard score to assess the risk severity of the operating condition based on the operating trajectory. Deep learning models are trained with the augmented dataset to diagnose the health status of the reaction. Simulation results show that the proposed physics-guided diffusion model outperforms data-driven models in terms of the quality of synthetic data and diagnosis performance for rare events.
items.summary_zh: 研究提出物理引导的条件扩散模型，为水煤气变换反应生成符合反应控制方程的稀有事件轨迹，再用合成数据平衡正常/异常分布并训练健康诊断模型；模拟结果显示其稀有事件合成质量和诊断性能优于纯数据驱动模型。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把物理约束扩散生成用于催化过程安全和异常诊断，针对真实异常数据稀缺这一工业痛点。限制是证据来自模拟，尚缺少真实装置、跨工况和现场故障验证。
items.abstract_zh: 随着世界转向可持续能源，氢气（H2）因具有高能量密度且不产生碳排放，可以作为化石燃料的环保替代品。水煤气变换（WGS）反应是广泛使用的工业制氢过程，通过一氧化碳和蒸汽反应生成氢气和二氧化碳。然而，严重结垢、催化剂劣化和热失控等事件会阻碍反应动力学和过程安全，并降低H2产率。这些事件很少发生，在异常条件下收集过程数据十分困难。在本研究中，我们提出一种物理引导的条件扩散模型，为WGS反应生成真实的稀有事件轨迹。该模型将条件去噪扩散概率模型（CDDPM）与反应控制定律结合，以生成物理一致的过程轨迹。条件特征使模型能够为通常超出训练范围的稀有事件领域生成高质量合成剖面。随后，生成的稀有事件轨迹扩充原始数据集，使正常与异常条件之间达到平衡分布。我们还提出一个危险度评分，根据运行轨迹评估操作条件的风险严重程度。利用增强数据集训练深度学习模型，以诊断反应健康状态。模拟结果显示，在稀有事件的合成数据质量和诊断性能方面，所提出的物理引导扩散模型优于数据驱动模型。
items.author_line: Md Abrar Rafid Siddique, Bibek Aryal, Qiugang Lu

items.title: ReGDiff: Guided Diffusion in Regulated Latent Space for Exploring Metamaterial Voxel Geometry
items.abstract_or_text: Metamaterials are artificially engineered structures whose mechanical and physical behaviors are strongly shaped by geometry rather than composition. Voxel representation provides a unified format for metamaterial geometry generation, as it can express diverse classes such as truss, shell, and porous structures within a single cubic discretization. However, voxel-based generation faces a plausibility-novelty trade-off: staying close to known geometries helps preserve geometric regularities, while moving away from them is necessary for novelty but may produce degenerate geometries. To address this challenge, we propose REGDIFF, a generative framework that couples voxel representation with latent space regulation and guided diffusion. REGDIFF introduces a repel-and-sink (RAS) mechanism to smooth the latent distribution of plausible geometries, and short-range repulsion (SRR) guidance to discourage generation overly close to known samples while maintaining geometric plausibility. We further contribute a voxel-based benchmark covering truss- and shell-type metamaterial geometries, together with an evaluation module for geometric plausibility, novelty, and diversity. Experiments show that REGDIFF outperforms voxel-based generative baselines, achieving +8.9% in geometric plausibility, +46.4% in novelty, and +128.6% in diversity on average across two datasets. These results suggest that REGDIFF is a strong geometry candidate generator for downstream evaluation. Our code is provided at https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff.
items.summary_zh: ReGDiff在体素表示上结合潜空间调节和引导扩散，引入repel-and-sink与short-range repulsion机制，在保持桁架、壳和多孔结构几何合理性的同时提高新颖性；两个数据集上的几何合理性、新颖性和多样性平均分别提升8.9%、46.4%和128.6%。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该方法直接处理超材料生成中的“合理性—新颖性”张力，并提供可量化的几何评价模块。限制是当前只生成几何候选，后续力学/物理性能和制造可行性仍需独立评估。
items.abstract_zh: 超材料是人工工程化结构，其机械和物理行为主要由几何形状而非组成决定。体素表示为超材料几何生成提供了统一格式，因为它可以在单一立方离散化中表达桁架、壳和多孔结构等不同类别。然而，基于体素的生成面临合理性—新颖性权衡：接近已知几何有助于保持几何规则，而远离已知几何对于新颖性是必要的，却可能产生退化几何。为应对这一挑战，我们提出REGDIFF，这是一种将体素表示与潜空间调节和引导扩散耦合的生成框架。REGDIFF引入排斥—汇聚（repel-and-sink，RAS）机制，使合理几何的潜分布平滑化，并使用短程排斥（short-range repulsion，SRR）引导，抑制生成结果过度接近已知样本，同时保持几何合理性。我们还贡献了一个基于体素的基准，涵盖桁架和壳型超材料几何，并配套提供几何合理性、新颖性和多样性的评价模块。实验表明，在两个数据集上，REGDIFF相对于基于体素的生成基线，几何合理性、新颖性和多样性平均分别提高+8.9%、+46.4%和+128.6%。这些结果表明，REGDIFF是下游评价的有力几何候选生成器。代码见：https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff
items.author_line: Wangzhi Zhan, Jianpeng Chen, Dongqi Fu, Dawei Zhou

items.title: Representation Alignment as a Bottleneck in LLM-Based Retrosynthesis Planning
items.abstract_or_text: While LLMs show promise in general reasoning, symbolic planning in chemistry remains a bottleneck. Direct ''SMILES-to-PDDL'' attempts fail because they force models to juggle chemical analysis and planning-language structuring simultaneously. We hypothesize that this failure stems from a lack of intermediate abstractions rather than insufficient model capacity. By decomposing retrosynthesis into molecule mapping, reaction mapping, and PDDL generation, we achieve high success rates where end-to-end approaches fail. This provides evidence that a primary bottleneck lies in representation alignment rather than raw model capacity. Our structural analysis demonstrates that intermediate representations are essential in retrosynthesis planning, highlighting the importance of representation-centric design in future systems.
items.summary_zh: 研究将逆合成拆解为分子映射、反应映射和PDDL生成三个中间表示步骤，避免端到端SMILES-to-PDDL同时处理化学分析与规划语言结构化；结果支持表示对齐而非模型容量是逆合成规划的主要瓶颈。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它以结构化中间表示改善化学规划，为LLM逆合成系统提供了清晰的工程诊断。限制是摘要未报告数据集、基线数值和实验规模，证据强度低于带完整基准评测的工作。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管LLM展现出通用推理潜力，化学中的符号规划仍然是瓶颈。直接进行“SMILES-to-PDDL”尝试会失败，因为这迫使模型同时处理化学分析和规划语言结构化。我们假设，这种失败源于缺少中间抽象，而不是模型容量不足。通过将逆合成分解为分子映射、反应映射和PDDL生成，我们在端到端方法失败的情况下取得了较高成功率。这为主要瓶颈位于表示对齐而非原始模型容量提供了证据。我们的结构分析表明，中间表示对于逆合成规划至关重要，并突出了表示中心设计对未来系统的重要性。
items.author_line: Hyunwoo Yoo, Cassie Huang, Haebin Shin, Li Zhang, Gail L. Rosen

items.title: End-to-End Agentic AI Framework for Cross-Dataset Medical Image Classification Using CNNs, Vision Transformers, Explainable AI, Robustness Analysis, and LLM-Driven Clinical Reporting
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Medical image classification requires more than high predictive accuracy. A practically useful artificial intelligence system must also provide reliable confidence estimates, robust-ness under image perturbations, interpretable predictions, and meaningful reporting for downstream decision support. This project presents an end-to-end comparative medical imaging framework that evaluates Convolutional Neural Networks and Vision Transformers across three heterogeneous medical imaging tasks: Chest X-Ray pneumonia classification, Brain MRI tumor detection, and dermoscopic Skin Cancer classification. The evaluated architectures include ResNet50, EfficientNet-B0, DenseNet121, DeiT-Small, and Swin-Tiny. The framework integrates transfer learning, class-imbalance handling, model calibration, bootstrap confidence intervals, robustness evaluation, failure-case analysis, Grad-CAM explainability, ensemble learning , and extensive performance metrics. In addition, an LLM-driven reporting component is incorporated to generate structured model-comparison summaries, explainability interpretations, and decision-support reports. The LLM layer is constrained to provide research-oriented assistance rather than autonomous clinical diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate that CNN architectures remain highly effective for structured radiographic images, while Vision Transformers provide strong performance and robustness for more contextually complex Brain MRI and dermoscopic imaging tasks.
items.summary_zh: 一个端到端医学影像框架，在胸部 X 光、脑 MRI 和皮肤镜图像任务中比较 CNN 与 Vision Transformer，并联合校准、鲁棒性、Grad-CAM 和 LLM 报告生成。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时评估性能、校准、扰动鲁棒性和可解释性，展示了不同模型家族在不同影像结构上的互补性，但仍是 preprint，不能视为临床诊断验证。
items.abstract_zh: 医学图像分类所需的不仅是高预测准确率。一个具有实际用途的人工智能系统还必须提供可靠的置信度估计、在图像扰动下的鲁棒性、可解释的预测，以及面向下游决策支持的有意义报告。本项目提出一个端到端的比较性医学影像框架，在三类异质医学影像任务上评估卷积神经网络和 Vision Transformer：胸部 X 光肺炎分类、脑 MRI 肿瘤检测和皮肤镜皮肤癌分类。评估的架构包括 ResNet50、EfficientNet-B0、DenseNet121、DeiT-Small 和 Swin-Tiny。该框架整合了迁移学习、类别不平衡处理、模型校准、bootstrap 置信区间、鲁棒性评估、失败案例分析、Grad-CAM 可解释性、集成学习和广泛的性能指标。此外，框架还加入了 LLM 驱动的报告组件，用于生成结构化的模型比较摘要、可解释性解读和决策支持报告。LLM 层被限制为提供研究导向的辅助，而不是自主临床诊断。实验结果表明，CNN 架构对结构化的放射学图像仍然非常有效，而 Vision Transformer 在上下文更复杂的脑 MRI 和皮肤镜图像上表现出较强的性能和鲁棒性。
items.author_line: Angadala APT

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for MRI-Based Identification of Autism Spectrum Disorder: A Systematic Review of Methods, Performance, and Clinical Translation
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a neurodevelopmental condition characterized by impairments in social communication and restricted or repetitive behaviours. Early diagnosis is important for timely intervention, motivating increasing interest in computer-aided diagnostic systems based on neuroimaging data. Objective This review aims to systematically review MRI-based machine learning and deep learning studies that classified individuals with ASD and controls and to evaluate current dataset, preprocessing methods, modelling approaches, validation strategies, and barriers to clinical translation. Methods A systematic literature review was conducted following the PRISMA guidelines. Studies published between 2015 and 2026 were retrieved from Scopus, Web of Science, and PubMed databases. After applying predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria, 86 journal articles were selected for detailed analysis. Results The reviewed studies were categorized according to the imaging modality employed, including structural MRI (sMRI), functional MRI (fMRI), and multimodal approaches. The analysis covered datasets, preprocessing pipelines, feature engineering techniques, brain atlases, and classification models. fMRI was the most frequently used modality, while graph neural networks, transformers, and multimodal fusion frameworks emerged as the dominant methodological trends. Despite encouraging results, challenges related to dataset heterogeneity, limited sample size, model interpretability, and clinical generalizability remain. Conclusions MRI-based machine learning and deep learning methods show considerable potential for ASD diagnosis. Future research should focus on multimodal integration, explainable AI, and large-scale harmonized datasets to support clinically reliable diagnostic systems.
items.summary_zh: 按 PRISMA 系统综述 2015—2026 年 86 篇 MRI 结合机器学习或深度学习识别 Autism Spectrum Disorder 的研究，并评估数据集、验证和临床转化障碍。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为 MRI-LLM/深度学习临床转化提供了较完整的方法学地图，同时明确指出异质性、小样本、可解释性和泛化问题；该项目本身为 preprint。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：Autism Spectrum Disorder（ASD）是一种神经发育状况，其特征是社会沟通受损以及受限或重复性行为。早期诊断对于及时干预十分重要，这推动了基于神经影像数据的计算机辅助诊断系统不断发展。目的：本综述旨在系统评估利用 MRI 的机器学习和深度学习研究，这些研究对 ASD 个体与对照者进行分类，并评价当前的数据集、预处理方法、建模方法、验证策略和临床转化障碍。方法：按照 PRISMA 指南开展系统性文献综述。从 Scopus、Web of Science 和 PubMed 数据库检索 2015 至 2026 年发表的研究。在应用预先规定的纳入和排除标准后，选取 86 篇期刊文章进行详细分析。结果：根据所使用的影像模态对纳入研究进行分类，包括结构 MRI（sMRI）、功能 MRI（fMRI）和多模态方法。分析覆盖数据集、预处理流程、特征工程技术、脑图谱和分类模型。fMRI 是最常使用的模态，而图神经网络、transformer 和多模态融合框架成为主要的方法学趋势。尽管结果令人鼓舞，但数据集异质性、样本量有限、模型可解释性和临床泛化能力等挑战仍然存在。结论：基于 MRI 的机器学习和深度学习方法显示出用于 ASD 诊断的较大潜力。未来研究应聚焦于多模态整合、可解释 AI 和大规模协调一致的数据集，以支持临床上可靠的诊断系统。
items.author_line: Nayak S, Gudigar A, U R, Yeong CH, Inamdar MA, Hegde A, Salvi M

items.title: Analyzing Genomic Foundation Models for Viral Sequence Identification
items.abstract_or_text: Rapid and accurate identification of viral sequences underpins clinical diagnostics, epidemiological surveillance, and the safety testing of biological products, yet the established alignment-based methods such as BLAST are inherently closed-set, with accuracy tied to how well a query is already represented in the reference database. Recent advances in genomic foundation models (GFMs) have enabled alignment-free approaches to sequence classification. However, their performance relative to traditional methods remains incompletely characterised. We evaluated GFMs, specifically the Nucleotide Transformer (NT) and DNABERT families, for viral sequence classification using a dataset derived from the Reference Viral Database (RVDB). Sequence embeddings were generated with mean, max, and CLS pooling, classified by nearest-neighbour search in an embedding index and compared with BLAST as a reference. Matching BLAST provided a particularly stringent benchmark here, because as a closed-set method it compares each query directly against the exact reference sequences it stores, whereas a foundation model must rely on representations shaped by broad, general-purpose pre-training. On sequences of standard length, the best model, NTv3-650M, reached an accuracy of 0.93, approaching the 0.97 achieved by BLAST. On long genomic sequences, evaluated on a much smaller test set, the difference narrowed further, with NTv3-650M reaching 0.95 against 0.98 for BLAST. Robustness analyses showed that all GFMs were markedly more sensitive to base masking than BLAST. Both methods indexed the same labelled reference sequences, and BLAST compared queries with them directly at the nucleotide level, so approaching it from frozen, general-purpose representations without any parameter update is a meaningful result. NTv3-650M emerged as the most promising candidate for further optimisation and deployment in bioinformatics applications.
items.summary_zh: 比较 Nucleotide Transformer 与 DNABERT 家族对病毒序列的无比对分类，并与 BLAST 进行严格对照；NTv3-650M 在标准长度序列上达到 0.93 accuracy。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了 foundation model 与闭集 BLAST 的直接、可解释比较，同时揭示模型对 base masking 更敏感；长序列测试集较小，结论仍需外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 快速且准确地识别病毒序列是临床诊断、流行病学监测和生物制品安全检测的基础。然而，BLAST 等既有的基于比对的方法本质上是闭集方法，其准确性取决于查询序列在参考数据库中的表示程度。基因组 foundation model 的近期进展推动了无比对的序列分类方法。但与传统方法相比，它们的性能仍未得到充分刻画。我们使用源自 Reference Viral Database（RVDB）的数据集，评估了基因组 foundation model，具体包括 Nucleotide Transformer（NT）和 DNABERT 家族，用于病毒序列分类。我们使用 mean、max 和 CLS pooling 生成序列嵌入，在 embedding index 中通过最近邻搜索进行分类，并以 BLAST 作为参照进行比较。在这里，与 BLAST 的匹配构成了尤其严格的基准，因为 BLAST 作为闭集方法，直接将每个查询与其存储的精确参考序列比较，而 foundation model 必须依赖由广泛通用预训练形成的表征。在标准长度序列上，最佳模型 NTv3-650M 的准确率达到 0.93，接近 BLAST 的 0.97。在长基因组序列上，测试集规模小得多，差距进一步缩小，NTv3-650M 达到 0.95，而 BLAST 为 0.98。鲁棒性分析显示，与 BLAST 相比，所有基因组 foundation model 对碱基 masking 都明显更敏感。两种方法使用了相同的带标签参考序列建立索引，而 BLAST 在核苷酸水平直接与这些序列比较，因此，未进行参数更新的通用冻结表征能够接近 BLAST，是一个有意义的结果。NTv3-650M 成为进一步优化和部署于生物信息学应用的最有希望候选者。
items.author_line: Buzkova, V., Dvorsky, B., Komarkova, M., Kollinova, K., Krupicka, R., Klempir, O.

items.title: NexuST: A Hierarchical Foundation Model for Spatial Transcriptomics
items.abstract_or_text: Spatial transcriptomics captures molecular states within cells and their organisation in tissue. However, integrating fine-grained gene information with spatial context at scale remains challenging for existing foundation models. Here we present NexuST, a hierarchical foundation model that repeatedly interleaves gene-level molecular modelling with cell-level spatial modelling, allowing the two levels to refine one another during end-to-end pretraining. For pretraining, we curated HumanST-46M, comprising 45.7 million human cells from 72 datasets across 11 organs and three imaging-based platforms. Across four held-out datasets totalling approximately 2.6 million cells, NexuST achieved state-of-the-art or competitive performance in cell-type annotation, region prediction, gene recovery and neighbourhood-composition prediction. We find that cell-intrinsic expression remains informative even for spatial tasks, as shown by an expression-only PCA baseline, while NexuST shows particularly strong gains where spatial context is essential. Overall, NexuST establishes a hierarchical framework that can serve as a general backbone for future spatial transcriptomics foundation models.
items.summary_zh: NexuST 以分层架构交替建模基因层分子信息和细胞层空间信息，在 HumanST-46M 的 45.7 million human cells 上预训练。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 跨 72 个数据集、11 个器官和 3 个成像平台，并在约 2.6 million held-out cells 上评估，适合作为空间转录组 backbone；部分任务仍接近表达量基线。
items.abstract_zh: 空间转录组学捕获细胞内的分子状态及其在组织中的组织方式。然而，对于现有 foundation model 而言，在大规模条件下整合精细的基因信息与空间背景仍然具有挑战性。在此，我们提出 NexuST，一个分层 foundation model，通过反复交替进行基因层分子建模与细胞层空间建模，使两个层级在端到端预训练期间相互改进。为进行预训练，我们整理了 HumanST-46M，其中包含来自 72 个数据集、11 个器官和 3 个基于成像的平台的 45.7 million human cells。在总计约 2.6 million cells 的四个留出数据集上，NexuST 在细胞类型注释、区域预测、基因恢复和邻域组成预测方面取得了 state-of-the-art 或具有竞争力的性能。我们发现，即使对于空间任务，细胞内在表达仍然具有信息量，这一点由仅使用表达的 PCA baseline 所显示；而在空间背景不可或缺的场景中，NexuST 的提升尤其明显。总体而言，NexuST 建立了一个分层框架，可作为未来空间转录组 foundation model 的通用 backbone。
items.author_line: Liu, H., Zhao, Q., Lin, L., Zou, Z., Cai, W., Sun, J., Zhou, Y., Alvarez, M. A., Gilmore, A., Rattray, M., Frangi, A. F., Zhou, H.

items.title: A new bioorthogonal PET reporter gene for cardiac regenerative medicine binding to DTPA-lanthanide complexes
items.abstract_or_text: The lack of non-invasive, quantitative methods to track the location and proliferation of transplanted cells hampers the clinical translation of cardiac regenerative therapies. Here, we establish a PET reporter for tracking human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC)-derived cardiac cells across complementary two-dimensional (2D) and three-dimensional (3D) cardiac tissue models. Methods hiPSCs were genetically engineered using CRISPR-Cas9 to express a human-derived, anticalin-based, bioorthogonal PET reporter (DTPA-R) that specifically binds radiolabeled DTPA-metal complexes. The engineered hiPSCs were differentiated into ventricular progenitors (HVPs) and cardiomyocytes (CMs). Stability of reporter gene expression and its effects on cellular differentiation and function were evaluated. Uptake of [18F]F-DTPA*Tb by DTPA-R-positive and -negative HVPs was analyzed in vitro, and DTPA-R HVPs were evaluated in ex vivo cultured porcine myocardial slices with and without radiofrequency ablation (RFA) injury. Phantom studies were performed to evaluate PET detectability under clinically relevant large-animal and human imaging conditions and to assess how activity distribution affects signal detection in relation to DTPA-R cardiac cell-equivalent numbers. Results DTPA-R expression was maintained during the differentiation stages of hiPSC-derived cardiac cells and had no measurable impact on migration, differentiation, and functional integration. PET imaging enabled the specific detection of DTPA-R HVPs in intact and injured myocardial slices. At the initial phantom scan, the measured activity corresponded to cell-equivalent numbers of approximately 3.2 x 10^6 HVPs or 5.5 x 10^6 CMs. The compact 200 uL source remained clearly detectable at 6 h, whereas the more dispersed 1,000 uL source progressively approached background activity, indicating that PET detectability depended strongly on local activity concentration and distribution. Conclusion This study establishes a bioorthogonal PET reporter gene platform for quantitative imaging of hiPSC-derived cardiac cells, with no measurable adverse effects on the biological parameters examined, and provides a methodological foundation for future translational and in vivo imaging studies. The approach may also be applicable to other hiPSC-derived cell products beyond cardiac cell lineages.
items.summary_zh: 利用 CRISPR-Cas9 构建 DTPA-R bioorthogonal PET reporter gene，追踪 hiPSC 衍生心脏细胞在 2D、3D 和猪心肌切片中的位置。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 同时检验报告基因对分化和功能的影响，并量化 PET 对约 3.2 x 10^6 HVPs 或 5.5 x 10^6 CMs 的检测能力，为细胞治疗追踪提供转化基础。
items.abstract_zh: 缺乏非侵入性、定量追踪移植细胞位置和增殖的方法，阻碍了心脏再生治疗的临床转化。在此，我们建立了一个 PET reporter，用于在互补的二维（2D）和三维（3D）心脏组织模型中追踪人 induced pluripotent stem cell（hiPSC）衍生的心脏细胞。方法：使用 CRISPR-Cas9 对 hiPSC 进行基因工程改造，使其表达一种源自人、基于 anticalin 的 bioorthogonal PET reporter（DTPA-R），该 reporter 可特异性结合放射性标记的 DTPA-metal complexes。将工程化 hiPSC 分化为 ventricular progenitors（HVPs）和 cardiomyocytes（CMs）。评估 reporter gene 表达的稳定性以及其对细胞分化和功能的影响。在体外分析 DTPA-R 阳性和阴性 HVPs 对 [18F]F-DTPA*Tb 的摄取，并在有或没有 radiofrequency ablation（RFA）损伤的离体培养猪心肌切片中评估 DTPA-R HVPs。开展 phantom 研究，以评估在具有临床相关性的大动物和人体成像条件下 PET 的可检测性，并评估活度分布如何影响信号检测，以及其与 DTPA-R 心脏细胞当量数之间的关系。结果：在 hiPSC 衍生心脏细胞的分化阶段，DTPA-R 表达保持稳定，且对迁移、分化和功能整合没有可测量的影响。PET 成像能够在完整和受损的心肌切片中特异性检测 DTPA-R HVPs。在初始 phantom 扫描中，测得的活度对应于约 3.2 x 10^6 HVPs 或 5.5 x 10^6 CMs 的细胞当量数。紧凑的 200 uL 放射源在 6 h 时仍清晰可检测，而更加分散的 1,000 uL 放射源逐渐接近背景活度，表明 PET 的可检测性高度依赖局部活度浓度和分布。结论：本研究建立了一个用于定量成像 hiPSC 衍生心脏细胞的 bioorthogonal PET reporter gene 平台，在所考察的生物学参数上未见可测量的不良影响，并为未来的转化研究和体内成像研究提供了方法学基础。除心脏细胞谱系外，该方法也可能适用于其他 hiPSC 衍生的细胞产品。

items.title: A plasma metabolomics workflow for breast cancer detection using quantitative GC/MS and machine learning
items.abstract_or_text: Blood-based metabolomic profiling has been widely investigated for breast cancer (BC) detection; however, clinical implementation remains limited due to variability in sample handling, analytical reproducibility, and overfitting during statistical analysis. We established a plasma GC/MS metabolomics workflow for discriminating BC from healthy controls (HC) using conventional machine-learning algorithms. Plasma samples (n = 360; BC = 180, HC = 180) were collected prospectively under standardized preanalytical conditions before surgery and the initiation of systematic anticancer therapy and analyzed using a quantitative GC/MS platform with automated derivatization. Feature selection and model development were conducted using three machine-learning (ML) algorithms (Lasso logistic regression (LR), random forest classifier (RFC), and support vector machine (SVM)). A total of 45 metabolite candidate biomarkers were identified, and the optimal number of metabolite features for each algorithm was estimated by a recursive feature elimination (RFE)-based strategy. The best-performing models achieved area under the ROC curve values (AUC) of 0.910 (LR), 0.893 (RFC), and 0.843 (SVM). We selected prioritizing candidate biomarkers consistently expressed across the multi-algorithm pipeline. A bagging ensemble model improved stability (AUC = 0.911) and reduced false-positive predictions in the independent HC dataset. In addition, model stability with respect to false-positive predictions was assessed using an independent HC cohort (n = 15) that was collected at a separate institution. These results indicate that a plasma metabolomics workflow combined with conventional multi-algorithm ML, algorithm-specific feature selection, and independent assessment provides stable discrimination between BC and HC in a moderately sized cohort.
items.summary_zh: 在前瞻性收集的 360 份血浆样本上建立定量 GC/MS 代谢组流程，用 Lasso LR、RFC 和 SVM 区分 breast cancer 与健康对照。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 标准化前处理、跨算法特征选择和独立机构健康队列降低了过拟合与假阳性风险，但队列规模仍属中等，且为 preprint。
items.abstract_zh: 基于血液的代谢组谱已被广泛研究用于 breast cancer（BC）检测；然而，由于样本处理差异、分析可重复性和统计分析中的过拟合，临床实施仍然有限。我们建立了一个血浆 GC/MS 代谢组学流程，使用传统机器学习算法区分 BC 与健康对照（HC）。血浆样本（n = 360；BC = 180，HC = 180）在标准化的前分析条件下、手术和系统性抗癌治疗开始之前进行前瞻性收集，并使用带自动衍生化的定量 GC/MS 平台进行分析。特征选择和模型开发采用三种机器学习（ML）算法：Lasso logistic regression（LR）、random forest classifier（RFC）和 support vector machine（SVM）。共识别出 45 个代谢物候选生物标志物，并通过基于 recursive feature elimination（RFE）的策略估计每种算法的最佳代谢物特征数量。表现最佳的模型获得的受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）分别为 LR 0.910、RFC 0.893 和 SVM 0.843。我们优先选择在多算法流程中保持一致表达的候选生物标志物。bagging ensemble model 提高了稳定性（AUC = 0.911），并减少了独立 HC 数据集中的假阳性预测。此外，还使用在另一机构收集的独立 HC 队列（n = 15）评估模型针对假阳性预测的稳定性。这些结果表明，血浆代谢组学流程结合传统多算法 ML、算法特异性的特征选择和独立评估，可以在中等规模队列中稳定地区分 BC 与 HC。
items.author_line: Ojima, N., Yokoyama, T., Nishiumi, S., Kikuchi, S., Yoneda, K., Kimura, M., Tanaka, K., Morimoto, M., Miyazaki, A., Tomita, T., Ohyanagi, M., Nagahashi, M., Miyoshi, Y., Ikeda, M.

items.title: Examining the Clinical Utility of Deep Learning Models for Perivascular Space Segmentation in Alzheimer's Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Open-source deep learning models promise scalable quantification of MRI-visible perivascular spaces (PVS), an emerging marker of glymphatic dysfunction in Alzheimer's disease (AD). Whether these models remain valid when applied to heterogeneous AD cohorts and preserve ground-truth derived biological associations has not been established. We benchmarked five open-source nnU-Net-based PVS segmentation models (nnU-Net T1, nnU-Net T1+FLAIR, mcPVS-Net, MedNet-PVS, ADNI-PVS-Net) against manual labels in 60 multi-site ADNI-3 participants balanced across cognitively unimpaired, mild cognitive impairment, and AD dementia, and in 12 publicly available scans from the VAscular Lesions object-level and segmentatiOn (VALDO) challenge. We evaluated overall, voxel, object, and lesion-wise Dice; stratified performance by region, diagnosis, scanner, PVS severity, and white matter hyperintensity (WMH) burden; and tested whether model-derived PVS burden reproduced ground-truth derived associations with AD-related biomarkers. Despite high internal performance, all models showed a specialist-generalist trade-off: the AD-trained ADNI-PVS-Net achieved highest internal performance (overall Dice = 0.58 {+/-} 0.14) but degraded most externally (Dice [≤] 0.11), while MedNet-PVS and mcPVS-Net generalized externally (Dice 0.27-0.30) but systematically misestimated PVS burden. Models were relatively robust across scanner and diagnosis but inconsistent across PVS severity, and some misclassified up to 32% of WMH as PVS. Notably, only AD-trained models reproduced the expected PVS-amyloid biomarker relationship; other models returned a null result, despite comparable or superior Dice scores. These findings show that internal segmentation accuracy and external generalizability alone do not guarantee downstream inferential validity. Careful model selection and cohort-specific validation against manual labels should precede clinical inference in AD.
items.summary_zh: 在多站点 ADNI-3 和 VALDO 扫描中比较五个开源 nnU-Net PVS 分割模型，检验内部/外部泛化及其能否重现 AD 生物标志物关联。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 显示 Dice 分数、外部泛化和下游生物学推断可能不一致，强调临床使用前必须进行队列特异性人工标注验证；项目为 medRxiv preprint。
items.abstract_zh: 开源深度学习模型有望对 MRI 可见的血管周围间隙（PVS）进行可扩展定量；PVS 是 Alzheimer’s disease（AD）中 glymphatic dysfunction 的新兴标志物。然而，这些模型应用于异质 AD 队列时是否仍然有效，以及能否保持源自 ground truth 的生物学关联，尚未得到确定。我们在 60 名多站点 ADNI-3 参与者上，将五个基于 nnU-Net 的开源 PVS 分割模型（nnU-Net T1、nnU-Net T1+FLAIR、mcPVS-Net、MedNet-PVS、ADNI-PVS-Net）与人工标签进行比较；这些参与者在认知未受损、轻度认知障碍和 AD 痴呆三组之间保持平衡。我们还使用了 VAscular Lesions object-level and segmentatiOn（VALDO）挑战赛公开提供的 12 份扫描。我们评估总体、体素、对象和病灶层面的 Dice；按区域、诊断、扫描仪、PVS 严重程度和白质高信号（WMH）负荷进行分层；并检验模型得到的 PVS 负荷能否重现源自 ground truth 的 AD 相关生物标志物关联。尽管内部性能较高，所有模型都表现出 specialist-generalist 权衡：AD 训练的 ADNI-PVS-Net 获得了最高的内部性能（总体 Dice = 0.58 {+/-} 0.14），但在外部数据上退化最为明显（Dice [≤] 0.11）；MedNet-PVS 和 mcPVS-Net 在外部具有更好的泛化能力（Dice 0.27-0.30），却系统性地错误估计了 PVS 负荷。模型在不同扫描仪和诊断类别之间相对稳健，但在不同 PVS 严重程度下表现不一致；有些模型将最多 32% 的 WMH 错分为 PVS。值得注意的是，只有 AD 训练模型重现了预期的 PVS-amyloid 生物标志物关系；尽管其他模型具有相当或更高的 Dice 分数，它们却得到无关联结果。这些发现表明，内部分割准确率和外部泛化能力本身并不能保证下游推断有效。在 AD 中进行临床推断前，应谨慎选择模型，并针对具体队列使用人工标签进行验证。
items.author_line: Tang, S., Younes, K., Penukonda, E., Hausle, I., Thropp, P., Lupo, J. M., Tosun, D.

items.title: PGG Enhances Olaparib Efficacy via cGAS-STING Signaling and Sensitizes Triple-Negative Breast Cancer to PD- L1 Blockade
items.abstract_or_text: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a highly aggressive malignancy and options for targeted therapy are limited. Although PARP inhibitors (PARPi) like olaparib (Ola) leverage synthetic lethality, their clinical utility is severely impeded by drug resistance and low frequency of BRCA mutations. In this study, 1,2,3,4,6-penta-O-galloyl-{beta}-D-glucose (PGG), a natural polyphenolic compound, can induce a state of homologous recombination deficiency (HRD) in TNBC cells by inhibiting the PALB2-BRCA2 interaction. PGG potentiated the inhibitory effects of Ola on the in vitro proliferation, clonogenic potential, migration, and invasion of TNBC cells. Mechanistically, the dual therapy triggered severe oxidative stress and mitochondrial collapse, which accelerated the classical apoptosis cascade and promoted the emission of immunogenic cell death (ICD)-associated DAMPs. The accumulated cytosolic double-stranded DNA activated the innate immune cGAS-STING pathway, thereby promoting robust intra-tumoral infiltration of CD8+ T cells. Furthermore, since cGAS-STING hyperactivation drives compensatory PD-L1 upregulation on TNBC cells, incorporating anti-PD-L1 antibody into the combination regimen further reversed the immunosuppressive barrier, achieving near-complete tumor eradication and maximum infiltration of cytotoxic T cells in vivo. Bioinformatics analyses further suggested a potential network of PGG targets associated with extracellular matrix organization, offering a bioinformatics-derived hypothesis for its theoretical involvement in modulating stromal tension and vascular homeostasis. Collectively, this study establishes PGG as a multi-functional therapeutic agent integrating intracellular synthetic lethality and innate immune sensing, while providing a preliminary bioinformatic rationale for prospective microenvironmental investigation. This study also shows PGG as a multi-functional therapeutic agent that integrates intracellular synthetic lethality, innate immune sensing, and microenvironmental remodeling to convert immunologically "cold" TNBC into "hot" tumors.
items.summary_zh: PGG 通过抑制 PALB2-BRCA2 interaction 在 TNBC 细胞中诱导 HRD，增强 Olaparib，并通过 cGAS-STING 与 anti-PD-L1 在体内促进免疫清除。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 连接 DNA 修复、免疫原性细胞死亡和免疫检查点阻断，给出从体外到体内的机制链条；结果仍为 preclinical preprint，不能外推为临床疗效。
items.abstract_zh: Triple-negative breast cancer（TNBC）是一种高度侵袭性的恶性肿瘤，靶向治疗选择有限。尽管 PARP inhibitors（PARPi）如 olaparib（Ola）利用 synthetic lethality，其临床效用却受到药物耐药和 BRCA mutations 低频的严重限制。在本研究中，1,2,3,4,6-penta-O-galloyl-{beta}-D-glucose（PGG）这一天然多酚化合物能够通过抑制 PALB2-BRCA2 interaction，在 TNBC 细胞中诱导 homologous recombination deficiency（HRD）状态。PGG 增强了 Ola 对 TNBC 细胞体外增殖、克隆形成能力、迁移和侵袭的抑制作用。在机制上，双重治疗引发严重的氧化应激和线粒体崩溃，加速经典凋亡级联，并促进免疫原性细胞死亡（ICD）相关 DAMPs 的释放。积累的胞质双链 DNA 激活先天免疫 cGAS-STING 通路，从而促进 CD8+ T 细胞大量浸润肿瘤内部。此外，由于 cGAS-STING 过度激活会驱动 TNBC 细胞代偿性上调 PD-L1，将 anti-PD-L1 antibody 加入联合方案后进一步逆转免疫抑制屏障，在体内实现近乎完全的肿瘤清除以及细胞毒性 T 细胞的最大程度浸润。生物信息学分析还提示，PGG 靶点可能形成与细胞外基质组织相关的网络，为其理论上调节基质张力和血管稳态提供了源自生物信息学的假设。总体而言，本研究将 PGG 作为一种整合细胞内 synthetic lethality 与先天免疫感知的多功能治疗剂，同时为未来研究其微环境作用提供初步的生物信息学依据。本研究还表明，PGG 作为多功能治疗剂，能够整合细胞内 synthetic lethality、先天免疫感知和微环境重塑，将免疫学上的冷 TNBC 转化为热肿瘤。
items.author_line: Liu, h. S., Li, X., Yang, c. X., xiao, l. M., Fan, c. T., Yu, J., Zeng, J.

items.title: Verifying Neural Networks with Reinforcement Learning
items.abstract_or_text: Formal verification can play a key role in ensuring the reliability of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) deployed in safety-critical systems. Modern DNN verifiers employ a branch-and-bound framework, which alternates between branching (splitting into smaller subproblems) and bounding (pruning subproblems) to efficiently explore the verification space. However, existing branching heuristics make greedy decisions based on static scoring functions. They do not anticipate long-term efficiency or leverage the growing availability of verification data to improve performance. This work introduces RSB, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to refine baseline branching heuristics. It trains an actor-critic architecture to maximize cumulative future rewards rather than immediate scores. The actor generates attention weights from observations of raw neuron features and learned graph embeddings, which rescale baseline heuristic scores to guide neuron branching. Evaluation on 600 challenging instances demonstrates that RSB consistently outperforms state-of-the-art branching heuristics, solving 11% more instances while reducing branch exploration by 50%.
items.summary_zh: RSB 用 actor-critic 强化学习改进神经网络验证器的 branch-and-bound 分支启发式，在神经元特征和图嵌入上学习长期收益。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在 600 个困难实例上同时报告求解数量和分支探索量，结果直接对应形式验证效率，而非只比较生成文本质量。
items.abstract_zh: 形式验证可以在确保部署于安全关键系统的深度神经网络（DNN）可靠性方面发挥关键作用。现代 DNN 验证器采用 branch-and-bound 框架，在分支（把问题拆分为更小的子问题）和界定（剪枝子问题）之间交替，以高效探索验证空间。然而，现有分支启发式依据静态评分函数做出贪心决策，既不预见长期效率，也没有利用不断增加的验证数据来改进性能。本文提出 RSB，一个用于改进基线分支启发式的强化学习框架。它训练 actor-critic 架构来最大化未来累积奖励，而不是即时分数。actor 从原始神经元特征和学习到的图嵌入中生成注意力权重，对基线启发式分数进行重新缩放，以引导神经元分支。在 600 个具有挑战性的实例上的评估表明，RSB 始终优于最先进的分支启发式：多求解 11% 的实例，同时将分支探索量减少 50%。
items.author_line: Hai Duong, Thanh Le, ThanhVu Nguyen

items.title: RGDT-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning for Rule-Governed Decisions and Their Justifications
items.abstract_or_text: We study reasoning in Rule-Governed Decision Tasks (RGDTs), where models apply external rules to case facts and justify decisions, as required in policy, contract, and compliance settings. Beyond the deductive capability emphasized by standard mathematical and logical reasoning tasks, RGDTs require interpreting rules and their applicability, assessing conditions from evidence, combining judgments under rules and exceptions, and providing checkable justifications. These demands motivate a benchmark assessing both decisions and their stated grounds. We introduce RGDT-Bench, providing 202.1K condition-level supervision slots across four task tracks and eight supported task-probe combinations that vary access to supporting information. Label-blind extraction and deterministic checks produce labels for warrant completeness: source-referenced coverage and consistency of stated decision grounds. The benchmark attributes failures to four process layers: rule use, condition, evidence, and aggregation, and checks the final outcome. Among evaluable correct responses, warrant incompleteness averages 40.2% across six evaluated LLMs and supported task-probe combinations. Such warrant incompleteness poses potential safety risks and remains difficult to detect: the best of seventeen existing evaluators reaches only 57.69% (random: 50%) task-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). To address this difficulty, we train a simple reward model with warrant supervision. It achieves 69.24% task-averaged AUROC among correct answers, exceeding the matched outcome-supervised baseline by 10.37 pp (percentage points) and the best existing evaluator by 11.55 pp. Beyond completeness assessment, the model outperforms both outcome-supervised baselines across nearly all response-selection comparisons, supporting RGDT-Bench's warrant supervision for RGDT reasoning.
items.summary_zh: RGDT-Bench 评估模型依据外部规则和证据作出决定并给出可核查理由，分解规则、条件、证据和聚合四层失误。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 它把“答案正确”与“理由完整”分开，用确定性检查和 AUROC 衡量理由可靠性，揭示了仅看最终结论的评测盲点。
items.abstract_zh: 我们研究规则治理决策任务（Rule-Governed Decision Tasks，RGDTs）中的推理：模型需要将外部规则应用于案件事实并为决定提供理由，这正是政策、合同和合规场景所要求的。除了标准数学和逻辑推理任务强调的演绎能力外，RGDT 还要求解释规则及其适用性、依据证据评估条件、在规则和例外下组合判断，并提供可检查的理由。这些要求促成了一个同时评估决定和所述依据的基准。我们提出 RGDT-Bench，在四个任务轨道和八种支持的任务—探针组合中提供 202,100 个条件级监督槽位；这些组合改变了对支持信息的访问方式。无标签抽取和确定性检查会为理由完整性生成标签：对来源有引用的覆盖率，以及所述决定依据的一致性。该基准将失败归因于四个过程层：规则使用、条件、证据和聚合，并检查最终结果。在可评估的正确回答中，六个被评估 LLM 及支持的任务—探针组合的理由不完整率平均为 40.2%。这种理由不完整可能带来安全风险，而且很难检测：17 个现有评估器中最好的一个，在正确回答上的任务平均受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）只有 57.69%（随机为 50%）。为应对这一困难，我们用理由监督训练了一个简单的奖励模型。在正确回答上，它达到 69.24% 的任务平均 AUROC，比匹配的结果监督基线高 10.37 个百分点，也比最佳现有评估器高 11.55 个百分点。除完整性评估外，在几乎所有回答选择比较中，该模型都优于两个结果监督基线，支持在 RGDT 推理中使用 RGDT-Bench 的理由监督。
items.author_line: Jianpeng Zhao, Haihua Xu, Haoyang Zhang, Shuang Qian, Yixiang Tang, Xintao Wang, Kun Sun, Pei Wu, Shuhan Zhong, Pengyang Wang

items.title: Codoku: Renewable Program-Reasoning Challenges for Frontier Coding Agents
items.abstract_or_text: Existing program-reasoning benchmarks ask large language models to predict a program's behavior on a given input. Coding agents break two assumptions on which these benchmarks rest: an agent can recover the answer by executing the program instead of reasoning about it, and fixed task sets drawn from existing programs are increasingly exposed to contamination, yet costly to renew. We introduce Codoku (code sudoku), a renewable benchmark in which a solver fills typed cells in a partial program to satisfy global static and dynamic constraints, such as a prescribed control-flow graph and execution path. Because a partial program cannot be executed and valid fillings are sparse in an exponentially large space of interdependent choices, neither tool use nor enumeration can substitute for program reasoning. Puzzles are synthesized from scratch via semantic reification, so fresh puzzles of controllable complexity can be generated on demand, each with a witness that guarantees solvability. We evaluate five frontier models on 300 puzzles through a coding agent free to use any tool within a fixed budget. Small puzzles already challenge open-weight models, whereas even proprietary models solve only about half of the large ones. Codoku thus offers a renewable testbed for program reasoning that can keep pace with rapidly improving coding agents. GitHub: https://github.com/connglli/Codoku.
items.summary_zh: Codoku 通过不可直接执行的部分程序、稀疏合法填法和可再生谜题，测试 coding agent 的程序行为推理而非运行程序取巧。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 谜题由语义重化从头合成并带有可解见证，评测在固定工具预算下覆盖 300 题，能持续更新并缓解基准污染。
items.abstract_zh: 现有程序推理基准要求大型语言模型预测程序在给定输入上的行为。Coding agent 打破了这些基准所依赖的两个假设：agent 可以执行程序而不是对其进行推理来获得答案；此外，从现有程序中抽取的固定任务集越来越容易受到污染，却很难更新。我们提出 Codoku（code sudoku），一种可再生基准：求解器要在部分程序中填入带类型的单元格，以满足全局静态和动态约束，例如规定的控制流图和执行路径。由于部分程序无法执行，而且在由相互依赖选择构成的指数级大空间中，有效填法很稀疏，因此工具使用和枚举都不能替代程序推理。谜题通过语义重化从头合成，因此可以按需生成复杂度可控的新谜题；每道题都带有保证可解性的见证。我们让五个前沿模型在 300 道谜题上接受评估，coding agent 可以在固定预算内自由使用任何工具。小型谜题已经对开放权重模型构成挑战，而即使是专有模型，在大型谜题上也只能解决约一半。Codoku 因此提供了一个可再生的程序推理测试台，能够跟上 coding agent 的快速改进。GitHub：https://github.com/connglli/Codoku。
items.author_line: Cong Li, Hao Sun, Zenan Li, Zhendong Su

items.title: A Critical Review of Theoretical Approaches to Compute Ionic Conductivity in Solid-State Electrolytes: The Case Study of Li3YCl6 and Li3YBr6
items.abstract_or_text: The development of next-generation batteries strongly depends on the design of electrolytes that ensure efficient ionic transport. In this context, computational in silico approaches have become increasingly important. Among them, molecular dynamics simulations are particularly powerful for investigating constitutive elements of batteries and providing a deeper understanding of structure-property relationships in solid-state electrolytes. Yet, for these systems, obtaining accurate ionic conductivity and activation energy is not straightforward as finding a force field to accurately describe the system and a robust workflow is challenging. In this work, a classical force field (CFF), based on the SoftBV bond-valence approach, and a machine learning potential (MLP) trained on density functional theory (DFT) energies and forces using the MACE neural network architecture, were optimized and compared to investigate the two solid electrolytes, Li3YCl6 (LYC) and Li3YBr6 (LYB). Our study proposes an integrated workflow (structure generation, property analysis with relevant statistical sampling) using standard methodologies based on the Einstein equations and a new method called STACIE[Toraman et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model., 65, 19, 2025, DOI:10.1021/acs.jcim.5c01475] (STable AutoCorrelation Integral Estimator) deriving these properties through the analysis of power spectral densities for transport property evaluation. Based on the evaluation and analysis of the contribution of the crosscorrelations between mobile ions, we provide clear rules to validate the use of Nernst-Einstein’s approximation to estimate the ionic conductivity. Results show trends in agreement with the literature. Notably the correct order of the conductivity activation energies Ea(LYC) > Ea(LYB), observed experimentally, is maintained. Overall, while CFF can provide an adequate representation when guided by experimental data, the strength of the MACE potential lies in its predictive capability. Using configurations generated by DFT calculations, the MLP generates trajectories with accurate crystallographic features from which realistic transport properties are extracted. Compared to their CFF counterparts, MLP results also show better mechanical stability at higher temperature for LYB, a softer system based on the analysis of solid-phase mechanical properties.
items.summary_zh: 以Li3YCl6（LYC）和Li3YBr6（LYB）固态电解质为例，比较SoftBV键价力场与基于MACE的DFT机器学习势，结合Einstein方程和STACIE评估离子电导率与活化能，并分析离子交叉相关对Nernst-Einstein近似的适用性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作提供了从结构生成到输运性质统计分析的可复现实流程，并明确讨论力场选择、相关性修正和高温稳定性。限制是研究对象只有两种电解质，且为ChemRxiv预印本，实验验证范围有限。
items.abstract_zh: 下一代电池的发展很大程度上取决于电解质设计，以确保高效的离子传输。在这一背景下，计算机模拟方法变得越来越重要。其中，分子动力学模拟对于研究电池的构成要素以及深入理解固态电解质中的结构—性质关系尤其有力。然而，对于这些体系，获得准确的离子电导率和活化能并不容易，因为既要找到能够准确描述体系的力场，又要建立稳健的工作流程。在本研究中，我们优化并比较了一种基于SoftBV键价方法的经典力场（CFF），以及一种使用MACE神经网络架构、在密度泛函理论（DFT）能量和力上训练的机器学习势（MLP），用于研究两种固态电解质Li3YCl6（LYC）和Li3YBr6（LYB）。我们提出了一个整合式工作流程，包括结构生成、利用相关统计采样进行性质分析，并采用基于Einstein方程的标准方法以及一种称为STACIE[Toraman等，J. Chem. Inf. Model., 65, 19, 2025, DOI:10.1021/acs.jcim.5c01475]的新方法；后者通过分析功率谱密度来评估输运性质。在评估和分析可移动离子之间交叉相关贡献的基础上，我们给出了验证使用Nernst-Einstein近似估算离子电导率的明确规则。结果趋势与文献一致。值得注意的是，实验观察到的电导率活化能顺序Ea(LYC) > Ea(LYB)得以保持。总体而言，在实验数据引导下，CFF可以提供适当的表示，而MLP的优势在于预测能力。使用由DFT计算生成的构型，MLP生成的轨迹具有准确的晶体学特征，并据此提取出真实的输运性质。与CFF结果相比，MLP结果还显示，在较高温度下LYB具有更好的力学稳定性；这一点来自对固相力学性质的分析。
items.author_line: Amély Rondeau, Namrata Jaykhedkar, Theodorus De Bruin, Manuel Corral Valero, Toon Verstraelen, Carlos Nieto-Draghi

items.title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
items.abstract_or_text: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. items.why_it_matters_zh: 把跨数据集泛化、校准、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性纳入同一基准，显示单一 leaderboard 不能代表临床可靠性；为 preprint benchmark。
items.abstract_zh: AI 驱动的视网膜图像分析不断进步，但评估其可靠性仍然具有挑战。在单一数据集上报告的性能无法反映模型在数据集偏移、不同临床定义或不同患者亚组下的表现。这一局限对于医学影像分析尤其关键，因为鲁棒性、校准和公平性是安全部署的必要条件。我们提出 FOCUS（Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift），一个用于评估视网膜眼底模型的跨数据集基准，涵盖仅视觉编码器模型（VM）、视觉-语言双编码器模型（VLM）和多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。FOCUS 在 10 个公开数据集上统一了糖尿病视网膜病变、可转诊糖尿病视网膜病变和青光眼性视神经病变三类任务；这些数据集具有不同的地理来源、采集条件和标签协议。该基准通过统一分析层评估排序性能、校准、亚组差异和图像质量鲁棒性。我们开展了大规模评估，覆盖 532 个基础配置和 228 个通过 supervised fine-tuning 与 low-rank adaptation（LoRA）适配的 MLLM 配置。结果显示，没有任何模型家族在所有任务和数据集上持续占优：通用 VM encoder 的平均排序性能最强，医学 MLLM 具有竞争力但表现多变，而双编码器 VLM 从轻量级适配中获益显著。Fine-tuning 能提高域内性能，但向外部数据集迁移时表现不一致，尤其是在校准方面。这些发现表明，视网膜模型评估本质上是多维的。FOCUS 提供了一个实用的公开基准，用于超越单一数据集 leaderboard，评估泛化、可靠性和鲁棒性。
